programme.title: Sex and the Married Detective
programme.desc: The disheveled detective gets some free advice from a world-famous sex therapist.

programme.title: Grand Deceptions
programme.desc: The detective is called in to investigate the death of a sergeant major at a training camp.

programme.title: Murder, a Self Portrait
programme.desc: Homicide detective Lieutenant Columbo investigates the murder of a famous painter's ex-wife.

programme.title: Columbo Cries Wolf
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the disappearance of the director of a men's magazine.

programme.title: Agenda for Murder
programme.desc: The disheveled detective investigates the apparent suicide of a notorious racketeer who was facing an indictment.

programme.title: Rest in Peace, Mrs. Columbo
programme.desc: When a crooked estate agent dies in prison, his widow vows to exact her revenge on the two men that put him there. After killing her husband's informing boss, she sets her sights on Lieutenant Columbo.

programme.title: Uneasy Lies the Crown
programme.desc: A dentist frames his wife for a murder in order to keep up his image and expensive lifestyle.

programme.title: Murder in Malibu
programme.desc: A famous romance novelist is shot dead in the course of what looks like a robbery.

programme.title: Columbo Goes to College
programme.desc: The rumpled lieutenant is invited to give a college lecture on criminology but ends up investigating the murder of one of the institution's professors.

programme.title: Caution: Murder Can Be Hazardous to Your Health
programme.desc: Columbo investigates the murder of a crime show host's rival with incriminating evidence.

programme.title: Columbo and the Murder of a Rock Star
programme.desc: Columbo is put to the test against an equally brilliant, criminal defense lawyer who murders his rock star girlfriend.

programme.title: Death Hits the Jackpot
programme.desc: A police detective questions a jewelry-store owner whose late nephew had a winning lottery ticket.

programme.title: No Time to Die
programme.desc: Columbo attends his nephew's wedding and as the couple get ready to leave on their honeymoon, the bride disappears; Columbo investigates and suspects his nephew may have made a few enemies on the police force.

programme.title: A Bird in the Hand...
programme.desc: Columbo investigates a hit-and-run, followed by a car explosion.

programme.title: It's All in the Game
programme.desc: Two women kill their two-timing lover but have solid alibis; one of the women tries to seduce Columbo to keep him off her trail.

programme.title: Butterfly in Shades of Grey
programme.desc: Columbo investigates a case involving argumentative radio talk show host Fielding Chase.

programme.title: Undercover
programme.desc: The disheveled detective sets out to solve an unusual double murder in which two men have apparently killed each other.

programme.title: Strange Bedfellows
programme.desc: The detective is put on the case of a man who murders his brother.

programme.title: Night Monster
programme.desc: A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

programme.title: The Night Walker
programme.desc: A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Revenge of the Creature
programme.desc: Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

programme.title: She-Wolf of London
programme.desc: Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: Count Alucard (Lon Chaney) makes Southern belle (Louise Allbritton) his bride.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: The Black Castle
programme.desc: An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

programme.title: Captive Wild Woman
programme.desc: A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes
programme.desc: Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

programme.title: Delirium
programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: After decades of living on the run, murder suspect Frank O'Neal (Billy Burke) returns to Los Angeles hoping to put his derailed existence back on track. O'Neal reconnects with an old flame, Karen Mellor (Sherry Stringfield), and finds gainful employment as a driver for an armored truck service. But, as he falls under the influence of a maniacal televangelist (Gregory Itzin), the unsavory impulses behind O'Neal's return begin to surface, threatening to destroy him.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: The Keeping Hours
programme.desc: A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

programme.title: Killer High
programme.desc: Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

programme.title: The Priest in the Churchyard
programme.desc: When a water main bursts at a cemetery, Brennan must identify and help reinter the remains that litter the grounds.

programme.title: The Killer in the Concrete
programme.desc: Booth suspects an organized-crime family when a partial skeleton is found encased in concrete, and he tries to lure the suspected killer out of hiding; Brennan gets a surprise visit from her father (Ryan O'Neal) while visiting her mother's grave.

programme.title: Spaceman in a Crater
programme.desc: When Brennan and Booth investigate a body that was found in a crater, evidence suggests that it had been in outer space.

programme.title: Diplomatic Immunity
programme.desc: The team investigates the murder of a Navy intelligence officer killed during a conference for foreign diplomats; Pride has some trouble adjusting to his new position at the agency.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a petty officer reveals a conspiracy in a tight-knit local fishing community; LaSalle awaits the final results of the tax fraud investigation into his family's company.

programme.title: In the Blood
programme.desc: Pride's father, Cassius Pride, is wrapped up in an NCIS case involving a notorious unsolved casino heist; Pride meets a family member he never knew existed.

programme.title: Pound of Flesh
programme.desc: After Pride's assistant escapes from a kidnapper, the team uncovers evidence of a suspect who is harvesting organs from multiple victims; Pride turns to a friend for guidance as he struggles with the ramifications of his recent brush with death.

programme.title: Sheepdogs
programme.desc: Following a deadly car explosion in the French Quarter, the team interrogates a professor and former member of a student protest organization; Tammy discovers a secret about Hannah's personal life.

programme.title: Close to Home
programme.desc: The team places Mateo Diaz, a high school gang member turned informant, in protective custody while they investigate the murder of his junior reserve officers' training corps instructor; Pride needs his brother's help to gain Mateo's trust.

programme.title: Risk Assessment
programme.desc: The team investigates the murder of a Navy contractor who secretly lived two lives for decades.

programme.title: Tick Tock
programme.desc: Pride is given a series of tasks to complete by unknown assailants who are holding Wade and his father hostage.

programme.title: He Kama Na Ka Pueo
programme.desc: A murdered man's body may hold the key to a 20-year-old case involving a kidnapped girl whose father never stopped looking for her.

programme.title: O Ke Kumu, O Ka Mana, Ho'opuka 'Ia
programme.desc: Adam investigates the murder of an undercover FBI agent who was about to wed the daughter of a Yakuza leader; Noelani is held hostage and forced, along with her mentor Dr. Chu, to operate at gunpoint on a criminal.

programme.title: Ho'okahi No La O Ka Malihini
programme.desc: McGarrett helps his sister spy on her shady neighbors; a ride-share driver and his passenger are murdered; the team teases the youngest members when Junior escorts Tani to a wedding.

programme.title: Hewa Ka Lima
programme.desc: Fugitive hacker Aaron Wright resurfaces to ask for help when his co-workers at the NSA are murdered; Junior speaks at the parole hearing of the drunken driver who killed his sister.

programme.title: Hana Mao 'ole ka ua o Waianae
programme.desc: Five-0 continues to hunt down escaped criminal Aaron Wright before he can sell cyber-weapons to the highest bidder; the lives of McGarrett and the team members are put in danger when a visitor comes to headquarters to make amends.

programme.title: Ua 'eha Ka 'ili I Ka Maka O Ka Ihe
programme.desc: A new ally helps McGarrett and the team when mob bosses on the island are targeted by an assassin; the team says goodbye to one of its own.

programme.title: Kuipeia E Ka Makani Apaa
programme.desc: Tani and Junior must plot an escape for themselves and several civilians after they become trapped inside a deadly tunnel collapse; Eddie the dog sniffs out a bomb that has been planted in McGarrett's home.

programme.title: E Uhi Ana Ka Wa I Hala I Na Mea I Hala
programme.desc: A plane that mysteriously crashed into the Pacific in the '80s is found, but with a recently murdered scuba diver inside; McGarrett and Quinn zero in on who planted the bomb in his garage; McGarrett formally asks Quinn to join the team.

programme.title: Ukuli'i ka Pua, Onaona i ka Mau'u
programme.desc: Five-0 enlists imprisoned hacker Aaron Wright to help when a young girl is reported kidnapped.

programme.title: He 'oi'o Kuhihewa; He Kaka ola i 'ike 'ia e ka Makaula
programme.desc: The team investigates a home invasion that turned deadly after a dangerous "monster" escaped from the basement; Max returns to Oahu with a very special guest.

programme.title: A'ohe Pau ka 'ike i ka Halau Ho'okahi
programme.desc: A deadly hit-and-run involves a driverless car carrying heroin; Tani and Quinn are stuck with a pair of YouTubers who are brought on a ride-along.

programme.title: Ka 'i'o
programme.desc: When the CIA informs McGarrett that his mother has gone rogue on her undercover mission and may have killed her partner, Steve goes to Mexico to bring her home and prove her innocence.

programme.title: Ne'e aku, ne'e mai ke one o Punahoa
programme.desc: The team searches for a killer whose plane crashed in the jungle with $10 million worth of heroin on board; Grover is thrilled when his niece Siobhan comes to try out for the University of Hawaii basketball team.

programme.title: Ka la'au kumu 'ole o Kahilikolo
programme.desc: Junior and Tani track down the thief who robbed his parents' home; Five-0 investigates the murder of a beloved philanthropist and the theft of his valuable koa tree; Danny moves in with McGarrett.

programme.title: O 'Oe, a 'Owau, Nalo Ia Mea
programme.desc: When Adam's girlfriend is kidnapped right in front of him, he shuts out Five-0 and breaks all the rules in order to get her back; the team investigates three seemingly unconnected homicides.

programme.title: Ka I Ka 'Ino, No Ka 'Ino
programme.desc: A tourist helicopter is shot down by a missile; a search for stolen artillery leads to a ghost from McGarrett's past -- Wo Fat; Adam makes a bold decision about his future with Five-0.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An actor is murdered while filming an alleged cursed horror movie.

programme.title: False I.D.
programme.desc: The police superintendent interferes with the capture of a murder suspect.

programme.title: Fatal Vision
programme.desc: Toby struggles with PTSD after killing a suspect while the IIB attempts to stop an assassination.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: A serial killer imitates a past murderer; while on maternity leave, Michelle must return to the IIB in order to save her reputation.

programme.title: Return of the King
programme.desc: After thousands of classified government files are stolen, the NCIS team searches for an underground group of hackers who were co-founded by Elvis Bertrand, Pride's old contact.

programme.title: Pandora's Box, Part II
programme.desc: NCIS agents McGee and Torres head to New Orleans to partner with Pride and his team in the search for the missing homeland security theoretical terror playbook.

programme.title: End of the Line
programme.desc: Painful memories come flooding back when a gruesome copycat murder leads to the reopening of a case for Wade.

programme.title: The Last Stand
programme.desc: Pride's longtime friend, state and military attorney Rita Devereaux, asks NCIS to investigate the disappearance of a JAG lawyer who specializes in classified cases and volunteers at a private military academy.

programme.title: Swift, Silent, Deadly
programme.desc: A highly skilled special operations Marine assaults six men in a bar, sending the NCIS team on a city-wide manhunt.

programme.title: Slay the Dragon
programme.desc: Tammy is reunited with her ex-husband, Ethan McKinley - who embezzled millions in Katrina relief funds - after he's tied to the murder of a crime boss' son.

programme.title: Quid Pro Quo
programme.desc: A deadly accident at a naval base exposes a unit of Seabees to a super virus and leaves the rest of the base and the city of New Orleans at risk for an outbreak; Wade is infected with the virus and given hours to live.

programme.title: NOLA Confidential
programme.desc: LaSalle must investigate his former partner in the Vice unit after the NCIS team finds a link between an international drug ring and the New Orleans Police Department; Rita looks into a connection between the mayor and illegal activity in Clearwater.

programme.title: Krewe
programme.desc: Pride listens in on a wiretap of Mayor Hamilton; the NCIS team investigates when Navy weapons get stolen in a train heist; featuring musical performances by Sheryl Crow.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: The murder of a Navy chaplain leads Pride to uncover a possible connection between Mayor Hamilton and illegal activity taking place in the city of Clearwater; Percy continues to face repercussions of her choices on a previous case.

programme.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
programme.desc: When Pride is spotted tracking one of Mayor Hamilton's accomplices on a crowded street, the suspect opens fire, putting innocent lives at risk before disappearing.

programme.title: Poetic Justice
programme.desc: Unable to trust anyone in New Orleans, the NCIS team calls in FBI Assistant Director Isler to help expose and stop Mayor Hamilton's sinister scheme.

programme.title: Rogue Nation
programme.desc: While Pride remains on probation after his rogue takedown of the corrupt Mayor Hamilton, his team is closely monitored by a strict supervisor; the team must secretly investigate after the FBI takes the lead on a case involving stolen nuclear waste.

programme.title: No. 1 Fan
programme.desc: An erratic whistleblower who calls Pride her mentor kidnaps him to help her locate a serial killer targeting young women in the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Chasing Ghosts
programme.desc: The team reopens a cold case when a stolen Navy-issue gun turns out to belong to a chief petty officer who died 40 years ago; the team makes their annual Thanksgiving dinner together.

programme.title: Billy and the Kid
programme.desc: A Marine's murder reveals new clues in the first case LaSalle and Pride worked together; a Thanksgiving celebration at Pride's bar.

programme.title: The Asset
programme.desc: The team joins forces with FBI Director Isler after a Russian operative with intelligence on sleeper agents disappears; Tammy partners with former sleeper agent Eva Azarova to assist in the disappearance.

programme.title: Dead Man Calling
programme.desc: The team investigates the copycat murder of an unsolved case from 150 years ago that spawned a legendary ghost story; Gregorio is spooked when the case is connected to a recent séance and a local medium.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Sebastian is placed on administrative leave after being questioned by the FBI about a foot chase; Pride and the team attempt to clear Sebastian's name.

programme.title: Acceptable Loss
programme.desc: The murder of a petty officer leads the team to a woman who is targeting men with high security clearance; LaSalle's father arrives to discuss the family business.

programme.title: Whack Job
programme.desc: The team goes after the killer of a man in witness protection, but finds there's more to the case than meets the eye; Remy is challenged by what he discovers when he reconnects with his mother.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: Bull helps a professional video game player, who has been accused of intentionally losing a championship game, sue his former team owner for defamation.

programme.title: It's Classified
programme.desc: Benny defends a whistleblowing army analyst who has been court-martialed; Marissa forces the office to work without its usual technology to avoid being hacked during the case.

programme.title: What's Your Number?
programme.desc: When Bull assists the U.S. Attorney's office with a manslaughter trial against a real estate magnate, his penchant for winning goes into overdrive as he realizes the defendant is trying to use Diana to antagonize him during the proceedings.

programme.title: Poniu I Ke Aloha
programme.desc: While McGarrett and Danno celebrate Valentine's Day with their girlfriends, the Five-0 team investigates the murder of a man taking a class on how to meet women.

programme.title: Hahai I Na Pilikua Nui
programme.desc: The Five-0 must once again engage in the twisted mind games of serial killer Dr. Madison Gray when she arrives at the HPD covered in blood that matches Alicia Brown's.

programme.title: E Malama Pono
programme.desc: After tracking down the missing uranium, which has been used to build a bomb in the middle of the jungle, McGarrett and Danny must move the explosive material through treacherous terrain before it detonates.

programme.title: Puka 'Ana
programme.desc: McGarrett and Kono suspect that an abused young girl may be the victim of a sex trafficking ring on the Island; Chin and Grover investigate a murder at a sober living facility.

programme.title: Huikau Nā Makau a na Lawai'a
programme.desc: The Five-0 helps a private investigator in the case of a kidnapped woman whose husband may have something to hide; Rachel tells Danny that she is getting a divorce from Stan.

programme.title: Ua Malo'o Ka Wai
programme.desc: McGarrett and the Five-0 are captured while tracking a dangerous nemesis to the island of Lanai; Grover takes his son to Chicago, where he testifies against a dirty cop.

programme.title: Waimaka 'Ele'Ele
programme.desc: McGarrett works the murder case of one of the last survivors of the USS Arizona; Adam uncovers bone fragments at his new construction job.

programme.title: Wehe 'ana
programme.desc: Danny protects a coma patient who was the key witness from his last case at the Hawaiian Police Department.

programme.title: He Ke'u Na Ka 'Alae a Hina
programme.desc: McGarrett gets a tip that someone is plotting a terror attack on Oahu; Chin and Abby face a difficult decision.

programme.title: Ua Mau Ke Ea O Ka Aina I Ka Pono
programme.desc: McGarrett risks his life when Five-0 attempts to rescue the young girls trapped in the sex trafficking ring they have been tracking; Kono makes a life-changing decision.

programme.title: A'ole E 'Olelo Mai Ana Ke Ahi Ua Ana Ia
programme.desc: McGarrett and Danny recruit Tani Rey to join the task force when a hacker releases a dangerous arsonist from prison.

programme.title: Na La 'ilio
programme.desc: McGarrett and the team work with an injured police dog that is the only witness to an ambushed drug bust; a former SEAL looks to join the task force.

programme.title: Kau Pahi, Ko'u Kua. Kau Pu, Ko'u Po'O.

programme.title: Adding Posi-traction to our '02 Old School Sierra
programme.desc: We trash the factory Gov-lock rear for a true posi to get both tires spinning. Plus suspension upgrades and a classic throwback exhaust continue our retro build.

programme.title: Dodge Challenger Tears It Up At NCM Motorsports Park
programme.desc: The Challenger tears it up at NCM Motorsports Park! Plus we'll help a viewer perk up her pickup in this week's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Adding '90s Flair To A 2000s GMC Daily Driver
programme.desc: We buy a '02 Sierra on the cheap and turn it into a reliable, powerful daily driver. First a leveling kit, wheels, and tires for a brand new stance.

programme.title: How to Install a Convertible Top
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: Taking our '69 Camaro into the Modern Era
programme.desc: We take our '69 Camaro and upgrade the suspension, brakes and tires to give it better handling and performance on the street.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 4 Steering Upgrades
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are adding a custom steering setup to their 2002 Ford Pre-Runner Ranger!

programme.title: Turning An Old Crown Vic Cruiser Into A Track Panther - Part 1
programme.desc: We start working on a new project with the novice racer in mind. We take a 2008 Ford Crown Vic Police Cruiser and turn it into a budget-friendly Spec Panther racing machine! Today we'll upgrade our transmission for better shifting and give the old power plant a tune-up.

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 2
programme.desc: Our small block 318 Mopar returns to be prettied up and completed on this episode. We cover it in a custom color and go through a detailed assembly process to get it ready for our Dyno. But things go sideways during the testing with our 318, first making excellent power then revealing major problems, and we hope we caught it in time.

programme.title: 1980s Mustang Cobra Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: This hissing Cobra gets dialed in with final touches, taking it from concept to coiled and ready to strike! Strap in for Project Sydewinder's first track day!

programme.title: OBS Pro Touring Chevy Heads to the C10 Nationals and Hits the Track
programme.desc: We add the final touches to our OBS Pro Touring Chevy C1500 and take it to the C10 Nationals where we put it to the test at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: AWD vs. 4WD Chevy 1500
programme.desc: There's a new purpose and a new plan for our Chevy K1500. It's the tips and techniques for a traction machine. GM's Greatest All-Wheel-Drive Idea Applied To Our C/K 1500

programme.title: Tearing Down a Pair of 351 Small Blocks: Windsor vs Cleveland
programme.desc: HorsePower goes on a salvage yard treasure hunt and finds a pair of 351 smallblocks -- Cleveland and Windsor. After twin teardowns, exploring the characteristics of each, the guys start the first of two performance build-ups.

programme.title: Power Nationals Muscle
programme.desc: We check out the 8 acres of muscle cars, hot rods, and classic cars, along with an autocross attraction at the first annual Power Nationals event at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Tires and Under Armor
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets brand new tires and some much needed under armor. Plus, our 2001 Tacoma gets a spray-on bed liner.

programme.title: Rescuing A 1971 Chevy Caprice From Driveway Death
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew rescues a familiar green 1971 Chevy Caprice, dropping a few tips and tricks along the way while diagnosing issues that can easily go unseen.

programme.title: Tearing Into Our AMC Javelin
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc have new project in the shop and have some unique plans that pay homage to the street machine era. But to do that they need to see what they have to work with.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: How Camshaft Timing Affects Engine Performance
programme.desc: The first-generation Chevy Small Block deserves its reputation as a powerful and reliable engine. It's the foundation for an old-school stroker build with an emphasis on durability.

programme.title: Sea Foam Truck Tech Sweepstakes
programme.desc: A beefy transmission and gear swap wraps up the Silverado giveaway truck that you can win!

programme.title: Lift & Shift
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: Lighting the Way Forward
programme.desc: Project Spartan, our 1969 Jeep Kaiser M715, is getting a major overhaul from the ground up. We start by upgrading the lighting system with modern headlights and some vintage C10 turn signals, then move on to the critical work of patching and reinforcing the frame; fixing all the damage left behind by years of rust and corrosion. But the real milestone comes when we reunite the engine with the transmission, build custom mounts, and drop the heart of this beast back onto the frame.

programme.title: 700 Horsepower '86 Jeep Wagoneer Monster Hits the Track
programme.desc: This is a non-stop, complete thrash as we turn a 1986 Jeep Wagoneer into a 700+ horsepower, two-wheel drive monster and put it to the test at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park.

programme.title: Body Kit Bolt Ons
programme.desc: Balling on a budget means spending your money wisely. Brian and Jason ordered a complete body kit for their 2011 Lexus IS 250 from China and today, they're cracking open the crate! Will it work or do they have to cut it to fit?

programme.title: Pumping Extra Ponies Under The Hood Of The Retro AMC Javelin
programme.desc: We put some muscle behind our 1973 AMC Javelin, and we see how far it will go on the Dyno.

programme.title: Turning a '76 Cadillac Hearse Into A Torque Monster
programme.desc: We take a '76 Cadillac Hearse and start turning it into a torque monster that will scream down the track starting with the drivetrain.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Custom Paint
programme.desc: After months of prep, the '89 Blazer hits the paint booth for a custom mix of color. And to accompany the panels will be a color-matched bedliner.

programme.title: Restoring a Scuffed Up Windshield - Road Runner Part 6
programme.desc: We get into some arts and crafts to create a one-of-a-kind emblem that redefines ransom wear and we'll use some wool to clear up Road Burner's eyes. When it's all said and done, the guys will be literally exhausted.

programme.title: 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
programme.desc: We continue the buildup of our 509ci W-Series engine as we get it ready to hit the engine dyno. We wrap up this vintage looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before we see how much power it makes in the dyno.

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.title: Hellcat '69 Charger Restomod Sold For $200,000 - How We Did It
programme.desc: Watch the three year journey of a 1969 Dodge Charger from barn find to crossing the block at Mecum Auctions in Dallas. Detroit Muscle's Marc Christ and Tommy Boshers complete the restoration that results in a $200,000 sale number at auction!

programme.title: Hot Rod LQ9 Cam Swap
programme.desc: Our GM LQ9 engine needs the right ingredients to turn it into a spicy hot rod street bullet.

programme.title: How to Drift Like a Pro: Better Grip Means Better Drift for Our Trailblazer
programme.desc: Part 3 of the Drifting Trailblazer. Pro drifter, Josh Robinson, gives a lesson on drifting, and the Trailblazer gets a suspension overhaul.

programme.title: Can We Make This Stock '91 Suburban Unbreakable?
programme.desc: In the series launch we take a 1991 Chevy Suburban and transform it into 'Project Unbreakable.' We test the Suburban at on off-road track, then return to the studio to tear it down to the frame, create a full build-plan, get the engine work underway, and begin fabrication.

programme.title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 3 The Ultimate Hook-Up
programme.desc: Our Chevy Avalanche, Project DragAlanche, gets a stronger rear end featuring beefier gears and an upgraded braking system built to handle increased performance. Then the factory rear suspension is replaced with a fully adjustable 4-link setup, providing the tuning capability and traction needed for maximum grip and consistent launches down the drag strip.

programme.title: Will Race Fuel And A Bigger Cam Improve Power On The Chevy 350 Dyno Mule?
programme.desc: We just can't stop searching for more power from our Small Block Chevy! It's getting high-octane race fuel, more aggressive timing, and a bigger cam.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger: Headers & Shocks
programme.desc: Cagetube, Rollcage, Shock loops and more, our Prerunner Ranger is getting custom headers and long travel shocks.

programme.title: Ford F-150: Preparation F
programme.desc: Today, we're prepping a big-block Ford to go in our big blue F-150. We'll walk you through the ins and outs of any and everything you'll need to plumb an entire fuel injection system from sump to solenoids.

programme.title: Turbo Tech Making 1200+ Horsepower
programme.desc: Turbo pioneer, Kenny Duttweiler steps in to lend a hand with our LME 427 ci LSX engine. Boosting this bullet with a high-tech turbo system produces a lot of excitement and big dyno numbers!

programme.title: Making Room for Bigger Tires On Our Lifted GMC Sierra 1500
programme.desc: Transformation of our throwback Sierra continues with a lift kit, 33" tall tires, and a tune-up before we hit the trail for some wheelin' in the country.

programme.title: 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco Is Ready To Roll
programme.desc: Today we finish the final assembly of our 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco with the installation of the interior.

programme.title: Crown Vic Cruiser Gets A Junkyard Axle For Its Spec Panther Transformation - Part 2
programme.desc: We continue work on our Ford Crown Vic Police Cruiser Spec Panther race car with a rear end swap, suspension mods, and upgraded stopping power.

programme.title: Ram 3500 Bullet-Proof Transmission
programme.desc: Ever wonder how a performance transmission can withstand 800 horsepower? We'll crack the case and show the inner workings. Plus, tradition meets 5000 HP at the granddaddy of all Tractor Pulls!

programme.title: Engine Powers' Favorite Dyno Days
programme.desc: As we say in Engine Power, "Dyno days are the BEST days!" and these are some of our favorite dyno runs.

programme.title: Chevy M1010 Gets Extra Power and Huge Tires for the Ultimate Mud Adventure
programme.desc: The Carcass duo add power, and huge tires to the Willys mud wagon for the ultimate mud adventure.

programme.title: Sleeper Granada Makes High-RPM Horsepower On the Chassis Dyno
programme.desc: From an underpowered grocery getter to a deceivingly fast hot rod...our 1977 Ford Granada has achieved sleeper status!

programme.title: SEMA Cars 2019: Getting Sideways with Joey Logano!
programme.desc: PowerNation highlights the amazing cars from gas to electric, including a ride along with NASCAR champion Joey Logano at the 2019 SEMA show in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Ram SRT-10 and F150 Get Lowering Kits: Muscle Trux Build-Off Suspension
programme.desc: Dropping it down for better traction, our SRT-10 Ram and EcoBoost F150 get new lowering kits. Plus, installing Detroit Truetrac limited slips, locks in more grab and go!

programme.title: From Classroom to Circle Track
programme.desc: As part of the Motorsports Team, students at UNOH build high-performance Stock and Modified dirt race cars. On Friday nights, they push them to their limits at Limaland Motorsports Park!

programme.title: Improving The Air Intake And Sound On The 2020 F-150 Sport Truck
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes giveaway 2020 F150 wraps up with more performance upgrades and a trip to the Grand Ole Opry in Nashville.

programme.title: SeaFoam Camaro Finish Up and Payoff
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: Model A Engine Mounted
programme.desc: Old skool muscle is on tap for the hot rod Model A pickup, when a muscle car engine gets a home between the frame rails. Plus square bodies are king at the LMC C10 Nationals in Texas

programme.title: F350 Dually Work Truck Upgrades
programme.desc: We bring in a new Ford F350 Crew Cab Dually and make improvements that will make the truck more functional as a towing rig and all-around work truck for everyone here at PowerNation.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Gets Custom 3" Stainless Exhaust
programme.desc: We start reassembling our 1985 Chevy K-10 square body. We'll add steering, brakes, exhaust, and glass. Plus restoration components that will make our square body look young again!

programme.title: Big Bore 363 Small Block Ford Part 1
programme.desc: Pat and Frankie dive into a brand new, bad to the bone, Small Block Ford that will make outstanding pump-gas power and be able to run on the track. We go through all the prep and machine work to get this powerplant ready to assemble later in Part 2.

programme.title: Power Nationals Trucks
programme.desc: We show you all the trucks, from late models to classics, including BIGFOOT, and a drifting exhibition, that are on display to the public at the first annual Power Nationals event in Nashville.

programme.title: Building the Next Stage of Test Sled
programme.desc: Mike and Pat move to the next stages of the Test Sled build including top end performance goodies, racing seats, an accessory drive, and custom tail lights.

programme.title: Dirty JL
programme.desc: We're on the trail! We are taking our Jeep JL to Burning Rock Off Road park, and the Hatfield McCoy Trail system in West Virginia to see just how dirty our Jeep can get!

programme.title: Go Fast, Spend Less
programme.desc: It has a 6.2 L V8, factory supercharged, with a manual transmission, but can we make it faster without breaking the bank? Joel and Brian test out some cost-effective enhancements on their 2015 Camaro ZL1.

programme.title: Custom Race Inspired Fuel System for a Buick Regal
programme.desc: With a nod to the Grand National we're giving our Buick Regal more Go Go. Fabricating a race inspired fuel system gets us one step closer to our '85 Buick Regal launch.

programme.title: Project Creep It Real Part 1
programme.desc: We tear into our 2012 Jeep JK to begin its transformation into Project Creep It Real!

programme.title: Tips for Custom Brake Lines and Hoses
programme.desc: All of the mechanical and electrical systems are getting buttoned up on our '85 Buick Street Regal. That includes tips and techniques for custom hoses and brake lines.

programme.title: Off-Road Wheeling in West Virginia
programme.desc: The XOR team and a group of off-road enthusiasts hit the trails on the XOR Adventure Ride 4. This year the team heads to the heart of coal country in West Virginia! Everything from the XOR JL Rubicon to the General Tire Tacoma to ATVs hit the trails.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 5 - New Chains
programme.desc: Prisoners love their chains, and Project Henchman is no different. On this episode of Detroit Muscle, the 1969 GTO gets a shiny new exterior look.

programme.title: Prison Tats
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: Carcass Off-Road Excursion
programme.desc: The Carcass crew invites a few friends out for a day on the trails. We put our Jeep JK to the test and flex it in the hills of East Tennessee.

programme.title: Fabricating a Buick Regal Custom Bumper
programme.desc: We add some GNX body panels to our '85 Buick Regal. We clean up and update a set of old Camaro/Nova wheels with fresh paint and trim pieces.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 6 Roof Top Extension
programme.desc: Our 1972 Camaro is ready for reassembly. The roll cage is welded up, so now it's time to reattach the roof. We'll show you some helpful techniques on how to reinstall your cut-off top. Plus, we head out to help a young viewer get his '91 Chevy Camaro back on the road in an all-new Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Reviving a High Mileage '69 Camaro
programme.desc: Destination "fun-town," Marc and Tommy are taking a '69 Chevy Camaro RS/SS to the next level! With performance, handling, and appearance upgrades, it's time to revive this ultra-cool muscle car giveaway ride.

programme.title: FErocious Ford Part 1
programme.desc: We bring back our beloved 1965 Ford flatbed shop truck and drop in a naturally aspirated 586 HP FE old-school V8 built by Engine Power.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 2
programme.desc: With Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live returning to the big screen, see our Designer Round Table and learn about the design process in making a toy monster truck. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live gives you an under the hood look at the iconic cars that call the Hot Wheels garage home.

programme.title: Camaro Test Drive and English Drag Racing
programme.desc: The guys take a test spin in the Valvoline Giveaway Camaro, and swing by the last remaining drag strip in England for a day of hot passes.

programme.title: CTS-V Wagon SEMA Build
programme.desc: Rare Cadillac. Big plans. We're partnering with EBC Brakes to transform a 2014 CTS-V Wagon with into the ultimate trailer towing SEMA showstopper.

programme.title: Can a Stock Cast SBC Crank live at 7000 RPM and 570+ HP?
programme.desc: E85 fuel promises high-octane performance for almost any engine. We put it to the test in our revamped 360ci "Compression Obsession" Small Block Chevy.

programme.title: Tired Supercharged Coyote Mustang Interior Gets an Overhaul
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew creates a custom exhaust with some TIG Tech, and they lay out a new living room for our EBC Supercharged Coyote Mustang.

programme.title: Tacoma Axle Swap
programme.desc: Jeremy and Eliza transform the Tacoma and show how to get more axle for your money.

programme.title: Adding 315HP to a 2016 Mustang GT with a Stage 2 Supercharger
programme.desc: From stock to rock, Tommy and Marc introduce the EBC Brakes Mustang GT Giveaway Car and give it more power!

programme.title: Finishing Our Crown Vic Sleeper with Handling and Braking
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc's old Crown Vic Interceptor is whistling a new tune with a turbo, upgraded suspension, gears and bigger tires. The only thing left is a hot pursuit to the donut shop that pushes the legal limits!

programme.title: 427 Cubic Inches of Naturally Aspirated HP for Javelin Trans Am Tribute Build
programme.desc: A 427 ci LSX engine goes naturally aspirated for an underappreciated muscle car.

programme.title: Blown 383 Stroker Has Trouble on the Dyno, What Happened?
programme.desc: The crew from Carcass needs plenty of power to move their 1-ton military truck. Our answer: supercharge a 383 ci V8!

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger gets a Custom Console
programme.desc: The transformation of this off-road beast continues as Eliza and Jeremy complete the interior, install a custom dash, and build a spare tire carrier.

programme.title: Project Creep it Real Part 2
programme.desc: We'll lift our 2012 Jeep JK more than 4 inches and get Dana 60 axles under it!

programme.desc: Un sacerdote se quita su hábito porque tiene mucho calor, un joven le ofrece bolearle los zapatos, pero es una trampa para asaltarlo, lo golpea y se desmaya. El sacerdote se despierta y no recuerda nada.

programme.title: Nada en exceso
programme.desc: Un hombre que se rehúsa a dejar de comer en exceso sufre un desmayo por comer mucha grasa. A pesar de que su esposa le pide que coma sanamente, su madre lo defiende. El hombre decide ir al nutriólogo para llevar una vida más saludable.

programme.title: Nadie sabe lo que tiene
programme.desc: Un joven se aprovecha de su novia porque ella está muy enamorada de él. Ella le hace todos sus trabajos de la escuela, mientras él la engaña con otras chicas de la universidad.

programme.title: Al que Dios no le da hijos
programme.desc: Un hombre se dedica a seducir mujeres al por mayor sin ninguna clase de remordimiento; sin embargo, pierde la vida en un accidente. Al morir, su hermano Víctor quien jamás pensó en tener hijos decide hacerse cargo de sus sobrinas.

programme.title: Nadie Escarmienta en Cabeza Ajena
programme.desc: Una joven trabaja en una clínica donde hacen cirugías plásticas y se enamora del médico, pero cree que él no se fijará en ella por no ser delgada y comienza a dejar de comer. Luego reacciona al ver que su amiga fallece por padecer anorexia.

programme.title: No dejes para mañana
programme.desc: Un niño se orina en sus pantalones y sus padres tienen que cambiarlo de escuela. El niño descubre que el compañero de clase que lo hostiga con saña brutal también padece de enuresis.

programme.title: Del agua mansa
programme.desc: Una joven se obsesiona con su profesor y trata de tener una relación con él, pero él la rechaza. La chica hace unas pruebas falsas para que todos crean que él trató de seducirla.

programme.title: Quien mucho amenaza
programme.desc: Una joven tiene que enfrentar el intento de suicidio de su madre provocado por su alcoholismo y por el desamor de su exmarido. La joven trata de complacer a su madre en todo para que no sufra más.

programme.title: El Hombre es Fuego, La Mujer Estopa

programme.title: Ahora es cuando chile verde
programme.desc: Un joven comienza a salir con un chico, pero su hermano y su exnovio se preocupan porque piensan que es un asesino serial que ha estado matando mujeres en su colonia.

programme.title: El que por gusto es buey
programme.desc: Mario busca integrarse al grupo de un chico que se dedica a robar cosas personales a sus compañeros de la escuela y a los profesores. Un día una joven acusa a otra chica de haber robado su celular. Mario defiende a la chica, pero esta se molesta.

programme.title: Al mal tiempo buena cara
programme.desc: Desde que era niño, Ricardo ha sufrido abuso sexual por parte de su padrino, quien también es su entrenador de fútbol. Al sentirse mal, le hacen unos análisis y le diagnostican cáncer testicular, por lo que busca justicia.

programme.title: Dile que es hermosa
programme.desc: Sebastián es un joven pintor que quiere conseguir a la mejor modelo para el concurso anual de retrato desnudo de la academia donde estudia. Sin embargo, se enamora de María Domínguez lo cual provoca una disputa con Gala.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Mariana decide tener relaciones sexuales sin protección con un compañero de la escuela. El padre de la joven tiene un accidente, Mariana quiere donar sangre, pero una enfermera le informa que es portadora del virus VIH.

programme.title: Ora veras huarache
programme.desc: Francisco es un chico muy peleonero e irresponsable que no estudia ni trabaja y está sobreprotegido y solapado por su madre. Un día, agrede a un conductor y sus escoltas lo siguen para darle un escarmiento. Sin querer, una tarde conoce a Francisca.

programme.title: Pa' decir mentiras y comer pescado hay que tener cuidado
programme.desc: Una niña muy grosera y malcriada se escapa de su casa para buscar a su papá después de enterarse de que su mamá le ha mentido. La niña conoce a un niño de la calle, comienza a valorar su vida en casa y le promete a su mamá que no le volverá a mentir.

programme.title: Siempre hay un roto para un descosido
programme.desc: Un hombre quiere hacer negocios con un traficante de órganos para salvarle la vida a su mujer, el criminal la mata por venganza y el marido después de pensarlo mucho, el marido accede a donar los órganos de su mujer, salvando varias vidas.

programme.title: Por Nochebuena y Navidad
programme.desc: Un hombre decide dejar de ser boxeador por su familia, pero la enfermedad de su esposa le hace volver a pelear para pagar las medicinas necesarias.

programme.title: Amor de lejos
programme.desc: Una mujer se enamora de un hombre que vive en otro país. El hombre viaja a México para verla y ella le cuenta que tiene cáncer. El hombre decide mudarse a México para estar con ella a pesar de que los hijos no lo quieren.

programme.title: Hijo eres,padres serás
programme.desc: Alejandro es un adolescente que decide irse de casa por tener discusiones con su papá, tras la muerte de su madre. Una fuerte experiencia con un criminal, provoca que el joven reaccione y valore la vida de su padre logrando perdonarse.

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.desc: Mariana se ofrece a ayudar a Fer con su VIH, pues su papá le niega su apoyo al saber que es homosexual. Mariana le confiesa a su padre que tiene sida y que sigue enamorada del chico que la contagió y su padre decide apoyarla.

programme.title: La vida es corta
programme.desc: Una joven sufre de una terrible anemia que le podría ocasionar la muerte. La joven queda internada en el hospital y su madre comienza a mostrar interés en ella. La joven necesita un trasplante de médula que le otorga su verdadero padre.

programme.title: Del dicho al hecho
programme.desc: Don Tomás y su esposa Lupe están por inaugurar su cafetería, mientras eligen el nombre que llevará, ella sufre un desmayo y la llevan al hospital. Lupe muere y después de un triste funeral, los hijos de Don Tomás deciden con quién se quedará.

programme.title: Palabras melosas, siempre engañosas
programme.desc: Después de perder a su padre, una joven se reencuentra con su madre, quien se dedica a la profesión más antigua del mundo. Ella deberá entender y ayudar a su madre.

programme.title: De las palabras no sonido, sino el sentido
programme.desc: Luego del suicidio de una chica, se decide tomar medidas drásticas para prevenir que esto vuelva a suceder.
