programme.title: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn.

programme.title: Fish Like a Bear
programme.desc: The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish.

programme.title: A Working Ecosystem
programme.desc: During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Wolf and The Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts.

programme.title: Neighbors, Old and New
programme.desc: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night; they hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

programme.title: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Casey and his crew wander the tidal flats and interior of Katmai and find the bones of a humpback whale that washed ashore.

programme.title: Lay of the Land
programme.desc: Casey and his camera crew arrive in Nepal and meet up with local tiger guide, Rajan Chadhary; a seasoned tracker, Rajan guides the team around Bardiya National Park's tiger habitat and establishes a lay of the land.

programme.title: On the Tiger Trail
programme.desc: While walking in the jungle, Casey and the team find a tiger; the tracks lead to a lot of dead ends, but they discover a plethora of other wildlife along the way.

programme.title: Into the Tiger's Bedroom
programme.desc: Casey and Rajan discuss different tactics for finding tigers: sit and wait for them to come to the water, or track them on foot through the jungle.

programme.title: Secret Lives of Sharks
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes of wildlife filmmaking with Andy Casagrande as he gets up close and personal with some of the most iconic sharks.

programme.title: Patagonia
programme.desc: Rene Araneda leads a tour of the Torres del Paine National Park in Chilean Patagonia.

programme.title: Southern California
programme.desc: Kyle McBurnie and Alex Warham dive into their California backyard deep in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: New York City
programme.desc: Jacob Steinberg gives a tour of a serene natural haven in his New York City backyard.

programme.title: Janos Biosphere Reserve
programme.desc: Eréndira Hernández shows off an extraordinary landscape in Mexico populated with animals ranging from huge bison to little prairie dogs.

programme.desc: Carne Adovada.

programme.desc: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

programme.desc: A volcanic eruption strikes fear in people, as there are more that could erupt at any moment.

programme.title: It's Up to Us
programme.desc: Join Pastor Bill Chapman from Llanelli, Wales as he delivers a powerful message on unity and team work as well as salvation through Jesus Christ.

programme.title: France
programme.desc: A temperate forest, consisting mainly of deciduous trees, stretches across the whole of Europe. The oak plays a special role, as its gnarled trunk and lush foliage are home to a variety of species.

programme.title: Canada
programme.desc: In the Great Bear Rainforest, the vegetation and Pacific Ocean come together in perfect harmony. The forest is home to countless spruce and fir trees, towered over by the Western Red Cedar.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: At the northernmost reaches of the world stretches the largest continuous expanse of vegetation on the planet: the boreal forest. At the boundary between shadow and light, temperatures are extreme, and living beings have adapted to survive. In this vast woodland, the birch tree stands out. Its white bark is a powerful insulator, and its roots, in alliance with symbiotic fungi in the soil, protect it from underground threats.

programme.title: Finland
programme.desc: At the edge of the boreal forest, where the light shines through, a sacred tree watches over the taiga: the birch. For the people of the Far North, this axis of the world prevents the universe from collapsing.

programme.title: Australia
programme.desc: In Australia, eucalyptus reigns over a forest where the trees compete in gigantism. For the Aborigines, dating from the time of the dream of their cosmogony, it symbolises the link between Earth and Sky and allows them to communicate with spirits.

programme.title: French Guiana
programme.desc: The ceiba tree, the repository of the Wayana people's founding legends, stands majestically above the canopy of the Amazon rainforest. It is a giant that provides a refuge for all living things.

programme.desc: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

programme.title: The Wanderer
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Warrior's Fate
programme.desc: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

programme.title: The Usurper
programme.desc: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

programme.title: Born Again
programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: To The Gates!
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: The Dead
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

programme.title: The Wanderer
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Princess of Mars
programme.desc: John Carter (Antonio Sabato Jr.) is on a tour of duty in Afghanistan as a sniper when he's wounded by enemy fire. He agrees to take part in an experimental teleportation procedure that could help his injuries. When he wakes up, he discovers he's been transported to an alien planet. As John explores his surroundings, he's captured by a group of aliens. He earns their respect when he helps them save the princess, Dejah Thoris (Traci Lords), and later battles an ambitious soldier (Matt Lasky).

programme.title: Mega Python vs Gatoroid
programme.desc: When a species of giant python invades Florida, park rangers breed mutant alligators to counter the threat.

programme.title: Mega Shark VS Kolossus
programme.desc: In search of a new energy source, Russia accidentally reawakens the Kolossus - a giant robot doomsday device from the Cold War. At the same time, a new Mega Shark appears, threatening global security. Now the world must figure out how to stop the deadly giants before they destroy everything on land AND sea.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: The massive prehistoric shark has survived the last battle, and the world is again threatened when a new, more dangerous foe is discovered in the jungles of Africa.

programme.title: Rozwell
programme.desc: Mysterious things are starting to happen as our Heroes drive through RoZwell, New Mexico. Bright lights in the sky and the appearance of a slightly 'spacey' woman, Bernadette, lead the team on an adventure in search of zombie aliens.

programme.title: All Good Things Must Come to an End
programme.desc: Our Heroes drive through Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab. They discover the CDC lab isn't just a lab...it's a submarine! Dr. Merch welcomes our Heroes aboard and not a moment too soon as the Zeros show up hot on their heels.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: In this animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to become human. As she explores the surface world, she must choose between her new life and her underwater kingdom

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: Due to a scientific experiment gone awry, a research team ends up in a strange land below the earth's crust. There they must fend off a series of strange creatures, including vicious dinosaurs and spiders. Meanwhile, above ground, Emily Radford helps military official Joseph Harnet with his plan to save the stranded research team. Their strategy is to use a high-powered drill to bore their way to the researchers, one of whom is Emily's sister.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: A mutated strain of giant and ferocious Amazonian piranha escape from the jungle rivers and eat their way toward Florida.

programme.title: 3-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: The world's greatest killing machine is three times as deadly when a mutated shark threatens a cruise ship. As the shark eats its way from one end of the ship to the next, the passengers fight the deadly predator using anything they can find.

programme.title: Megalodon: The Frenzy
programme.desc: The stakes have never been higher when a "frenzy" of five Megalodons, spawn of the original, terrorizes the open ocean.

programme.title: Warren's Wedding
programme.desc: Shaken by the death of one of the group and losing faith in Warren's dream, our Heroes come upon a group of evil "Zuggalo" clown-style bandits torturing a captive.

programme.title: Anneliese: The Exorcist Tapes
programme.desc: In the tradition of PARANORMAL ACTIVITY, found footage documents the real-life exorcisms of Anneliese Michel, history's most notorious victim of demonic possession.

programme.title: Nazi Overlord
programme.desc: Against the background of the D-Day invasion, a US military unit must rescue a brilliant British scientist, who is held captive by the most dangerous SS guards, deep in enemy territory. The Allies' victory depends on the success of this mission.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace, and nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air.

programme.title: 100 Below Zero
programme.desc: When a chain of volcanic eruptions rips through Europe, the enormous ash cloud blocks out the sun, plunging the continent into a new ice age. An American couple must find their kids and get them out of Paris before it freezes over.

programme.title: Little Dead Rotting Hood
programme.desc: The residents of a small town discover that something more sinister than killer wolves is lurking in the backwoods: first the wolves start turning up dead...then people.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. But a once thought to be extinct fifty-foot boa constrictor is out lurking in brush, hungry for blood.

programme.title: Hillside Cannibals
programme.desc: Born over 400 years ago, Sawney Bean and his inbred clan slaughtered and devoured thousands. To this day, the brutal cannibals lurk in seaside caves, preying on anyone who crosses their path.

programme.title: Izzie's Way Home
programme.desc: A constantly picked-on aquarium fish escapes her yacht home, unaware of the dangers that await her in the open ocean. With the help of other misfit sea creatures, she learns not only how to brave the perils of the deep, but how to be true to herself.

programme.title: Monster Island
programme.desc: As the world tries to stop a giant Kaiju bent on destruction more and more monsters appear - each one more terrible than the last - leaving mankind defenseless until our heroes reach out to a specialist versed in monster lore.

programme.title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire
programme.desc: In this gothic thriller, Detective Amelia Van Helsing is on the desperate hunt for the killer responsible for a string of grisly murders targeting young women. Matters only worsen when all evidence leads to the seemingly untouchable Count Dracula. And when Van Helsing's girlfriend vanishes, she is forced to question the very existence of monsters in a final showdown with the enigmatic count.

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: Doctor of the Dead
programme.desc: A change in plans has the team rerouted to a Colorado viral lab located in an abandoned but still operational nuclear missile silo where our heroes search for Doctor Merch, the developer of the experimental vaccine given to Murphy in the pilot.

programme.title: The Anacondas
programme.desc: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

programme.title: 6 Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: What is supposed to be a marriage boot camp on a remote island turns into the ultimate test for survival when a 6-headed shark starts attacking the beach. Trapped with minimal weapons, they discover that no one is safe in the water or on land.

programme.title: Haunting of Whaley House
programme.desc: When a tour guide breaks into America's Most Haunted House, a bit of amateur ghost hunting with friends turns into more horror than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Frankenstein's Bride
programme.desc: On the day of Frankenstein's Monster and the Bride of Frankenstein's Monster's wedding, villagers riot and kill Frankenstein. The Bride escapes, vows revenge, and eventually resurrects Frankenstein's Monster, - leading a trail of blood in her wake.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.desc: A former gladiator is to be married, but his wife is slain the night before. He must now fight his way through bandits and murderers to find the man who did it - the leader of the most vicious group in the region. He tracks the group down, only to discover the leader of this horrible group his own brother, jealous of his fame and notoriety his brother had as a gladiator. Now on a mission to find him, he must do the unthinkable - murder his own brother to avenge his wife.

programme.title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
programme.desc: In this modern retelling of the classic tale, facing certain defeat, Merlin banishes the evil enchantress Morgana and her son Mordred to the ends of universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth, hell-bent on destroying every last descendant of King Arthur and his Knights.

programme.title: Deadline
programme.desc: Alone and desolate, Martin Sanders is a recluse whose only for of entertainment comes from eavesdropping on the conversations of strangers. Slowly it becomes clear that he is not simply overhearing the passions of innocents... but the trappings of a serial killer... one that lives in his building and knows Martin has been listening. Now Martin has to find the identity of the killer before he finds his next victim. It is a vicious game of cat and mouse...

programme.title: Megalodon
programme.desc: While searching for an unidentified submersible, a military vessel crosses paths with a giant shark & are forced to use only what they have on board to defend themselves from the monstrous beast.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: When a freak hurricane swamps Los Angeles, thousands of sharks terrorize the waterlogged populace, and nature's deadliest killer rules sea, land, and air.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.

programme.title: Murphy's Law
programme.desc: Three strangers earn their way into the team and take a keen interest in Murphy. As their interest in Murphy takes a deadly turn, he must use his emerging zombie qualities to save the rest of our heroes.

programme.title: Nightmare Wedding
programme.desc: Sandy's past indiscretion with her fiancé's best friend Roman comes back to haunt her when he becomes their best man. Delusional and deranged, Roman will stop at nothing to make Sandy his own bride.

programme.title: Ape vs. Monster
programme.desc: An ape, lost in space, crash-lands back to Earth. The vessel oozes a sludge that triggers massive growth in both the ape, as well as a passing Gila monster. Once the creatures reach titanic size, their paths cross again, leading to a giant brawl in which Mankind hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln vs Zombies
programme.desc: While the Civil War rages on, President Abraham Lincoln must undertake an even more daunting task: Destroying the Confederate Undead.

programme.title: Asteroid-a-geddon
programme.desc: A global summit fails to stop a massive asteroid headed straight for Earth. With the outlook now bleak, a young tech genius assembles her own team of specialists, using aeronautics, in a last-ditch effort to stop the asteroid before it's too late.

programme.title: Sinbad And The War Of The Furies
programme.desc: On a treasure hunt gone wrong, modern-day adventurer Sinbad accidentally releases the Furies, three beautiful but terrible ancient beings powerful enough to threaten life on Earth.

programme.title: Zoombies
programme.desc: When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

programme.title: The Terminators
programme.desc: In the near future, people utilize cyborgs for labor, but the vastly intelligent robots rebel against their masters and begin to take over human civilization through mass destruction. A small group of survivors, led by Sheriff Reed Carpenter (A Martinez), plans to stop the cyborgs, tapping inventor Kurt Ross (Jeremy London) for help. Using a space shuttle designed by Ross, Carpenter and his team head for a control center in outer space that has the power to shut down the machines.

programme.title: Dudas otra vez
programme.desc: Doña Julieta escucha a Omar declararle su amor a Aurora y comienza a investigar. Tomás lleva a Alicia de compras y a conocer a su madre para poder casarse.

programme.title: Novio oficial
programme.desc: Lety organiza una reunión para anunciar su noviazgo con Aldo; Alicia intenta caerle bien a la mamá de Tomás para que acepte su relación; Fernando le cuenta a Omar lo que pasó en la fiesta.

programme.title: La nueva imagen
programme.desc: Los integrantes del Comité del Concepto acuerdan que Aurora sea la nueva imagen de la campaña de la empresa, aunque Lety está en total desacuerdo. Marcia le aconseja a Alicia no precipitarse para casarse con Tomás.

programme.title: La cita de Aurora
programme.desc: Martha y su esposo deciden comprarse una casa; Lety acude a una cita disfrazada de Aurora; Alicia les dice a las del cuartel que canceló su boda.

programme.title: Despedido
programme.desc: Omar presenta a los clientes de Conceptos una impostora de Aurora, pero solo logra que lo despidan; Alicia reanuda sus planes de boda.

programme.title: Despedida de solteros
programme.desc: Tomás invita a Celso y a Simón a su despedida de soltero; Alicia le pide a Marcia que le organice la despedida, pero se termina haciendo en casa de Lety; Aurora acepta trabajar para Conceptos.

programme.title: La novia
programme.desc: Después de muchas dificultades, Lety logra firmar el contrato de Aurora con Conceptos; Alicia y Tomás preparan todo para su boda; Omar sufre desempleado y sin amor.

programme.title: Aires de diva
programme.desc: Marcia se muda con Fernando y Omar; Tomás y Alicia afinan detalles para su boda; Lety conoce a una amiga de Aldo llamada Carmina.

programme.title: Luces, cámara, acción
programme.desc: Las mujeres del cuartel se presentan en Televisa para hablar con Juan José Origel sobre la mujer misteriosa; Aurora comienza con la filmación del comercial de Conceptos.

programme.title: Boda
programme.desc: Carolina se pone celosa por la obsesión de Omar con Aurora; el comité planea un nuevo programa televisivo; Alicia y Tomás celebran su boda.

programme.title: Fiesta de ensueño
programme.desc: Mientras todos celebran en la boda de Alicia y Tomás, Marcia llora por Fernando; Carolina empieza a reconocer sus sentimientos por Omar.

programme.title: Proyecto piloto
programme.desc: Debido a la falta de actores, Fernando decide protagonizar el episodio piloto del programa de televisión de Conceptos; Aldo empieza a trabajar con Carmina en un libro de cocina.

programme.title: Éxito y culpa
programme.desc: Gracias a Fernando, la presentación del episodio piloto es un éxito; Lety comienza a sentirse culpable por su doble identidad y quiere confesarle la verdad a Aldo y su asistente.

programme.title: Nuevos proyectos
programme.desc: Alicia y Tomás regresan de su luna de miel y Tomás le muestra a Alicia su nueva casa; Aurora acepta hacer el programa de televisión de Fernando.

programme.title: Ni se imagina
programme.desc: Aldo le propone matrimonio a Lety; Fernando decide coquetear con Aurora para darle celos a Lety; Alicia y Tomás inician su vida de casados.

programme.title: Despilfarrando
programme.desc: Aldo y Fernando aclaran su situación respecto a Lety; Carolina le cuenta a Luigi y Marcia cómo se siente por Omar; Alicia despilfarra el dinero de Tomás.

programme.title: Descubriendo el corazón
programme.desc: Omar descubre sus sentimientos hacia Carolina; las mujeres del cuartel se preparan para su cita con Fernando Colunga; Fernando le prepara una sorpresa a Lety.

programme.title: Indiferencia
programme.desc: Lety le dice a doña Julieta que se casará con Aldo; Omar está tan feliz con Carolina, que se muestra indiferente con Aurora; comienzan las grabaciones para el programa de televisión.

programme.title: Misterio perdido
programme.desc: Comienzan las complicaciones en la filmación del programa de televisión; Omar le rompe el corazón a Carolina; Fernando descubre la verdadera identidad de Aurora.

programme.title: Compulsiones
programme.desc: Lety está decidida a desaparecer a Aurora de su vida; Omar intenta recuperar a Carolina; Irmita y Sara llevan a Martha a una reunión de comedores compulsivos.

programme.title: Embarazada
programme.desc: Aldo, Fernando y los medios de comunicación presionan a Lety por la desaparición de Aurora; Alicia le dice a Tomás que está embarazada.

programme.title: En su lugar
programme.desc: Martha está decidida a remediar su desorden alimenticio; doña Julieta regaña a Lety por apresurar su boda con Aldo, ya que sigue queriendo a Fernando, además le pide que aclare el malentendido de Aurora.

programme.title: El sacrificio
programme.desc: Tomás le cuenta a Lety que doña Julieta está intentando sabotear su boda con Aldo; Omar acude con Tomás para poder conquistar a Carolina.

programme.title: Indiscreta
programme.desc: Gracias a doña Julieta, Fernando se entera de la verdadera identidad de Aurora; Alicia y Tomás pasan su primera noche juntos.

programme.title: Yo te apoyo
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lety que debe quedarse con Aldo y que él apoyará su relación; Simón les enseña a las del cuartel su título en informática; Marcia y Luigi salen de compras y alguien los sigue.

programme.title: Hombre nuevo
programme.desc: Simón recibe su nuevo puesto en Conceptos y le propone matrimonio a Paula María; Fernando y Omar llevan al nuevo coordinador de informática a celebrar su próxima boda.

programme.title: Malentendidos
programme.desc: Lety decide suspender su boda con Aldo, quien se pelea con Fernando; Simón se despide de Jaimito y Paula María.

programme.title: La boda de Paula María
programme.desc: Lety se da cuenta de que necesita a Aurora para ayudar a Aldo a recuperar su restaurante; Simón y Paula María se casan; los empleados de Conceptos se esfuerzan por juntar a Omar con Carolina.

programme.title: Intervención policial

programme.desc: Chief Inspector Barnaby is called in following the death of a cult leader and finds clues that point to a ruthless tycoon searching for his daughter.

programme.title: The Wolf Hunter of Little Worthy
programme.desc: After a local photographer wins an urban myth competition with his creation of The Wolf Hunter, it unexpectedly gains a cult following. However, when a man is killed, Barnaby and Winter must investigate if this myth has become murderous reality.

programme.title: The Stitcher Society
programme.desc: A local outcast, who was controversially acquitted of murder years earlier, is the latest inductee into a post-operative heart rehab club. Following his arrival, members' dreams of a second chance at life begin to be cut short.

programme.title: Happy Families
programme.desc: As the owners of Karras Games gather for a murder mystery weekend, the immersive experience takes a puzzling twist when a killer strikes for real. The police's detective skills are put to the test as they are forced to solve this case on their own.

programme.title: The Scarecrow Murders
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations; the investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

programme.title: Death Prepare
programme.desc: The Midsomer Mummers, an amateur operatic society, rehearses for its charity concert when the body of an unknown man is found in the theatre; the investigation quickly becomes a race to discover who is desperate to take centre stage.

programme.title: The Witches of Angel's Rise
programme.desc: Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

programme.title: The Made to Measure Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. When Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate - and the village starts to reveal its secrets.

programme.title: The Sword of Guillaume
programme.desc: Barnaby joins a trip from Midsomer Parva to Brighton because he's suspicious about a deal to buy coastal land for holiday chalets by Causton's mayor. Also against the proposal is Lady Matilda William, a descendant of a French knight Sir Richard Guillaume, whose son Richard will be the last of the line because of brain damage sustained in an attack 20 years ago.

programme.title: Blood on the Saddle
programme.desc: Trouble seems to be brewing in the pretty village of Ford Florey when a tract of waste ground dubbed 'the Swamp' becomes the focus of a land dispute between two old agricultural families and a band of travellers. Things get nasty at the town's annual fair when a woman is shot for real during a shoot-out reconstruction at the Wild West show. Barnaby and Jones uncover a series of seething grudges within the village.

programme.title: The Silent Land
programme.desc: After Joyce Barnaby swerves off the road into a ditch, believing she has hit someone, the body of a librarian is found in a nearby cemetery. Amid stories of ghosts and haunted buildings, can DCI Tom Barnaby convince his wife that she is not to blame - and at the same time identify the real killer on the loose in March Magna?

programme.title: Master Class
programme.desc: During a masterclass for talented young musicians held by famous pianist Sir Michael Fielding, prodigy Zoe Stock is shocked to witness a woman drowning in the river, leaving a baby on the bank. When police arrive, however, there is no sign of the woman or her child. DCI Tom Barnaby is struck by the similarity of the reported drowning to a mysterious case from 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Noble Art
programme.desc: Betrayal, infidelity and blackmail fester as plans to re-enact a Victorian prizefight turn nasty - and even DCI Barnaby finds his judgement clouded by an old friend. Midsomer Morchard welcomes back local boxer John Kinsella from his world title fight victory in New York. Meanwhile, Kinsella's ruthless and controlling promoter Frank Bishop goes to see solicitor Giles Braithwaite, only to find the lawyer dead.

programme.title: Not in My Backyard
programme.desc: A planning dispute turns to murder after a leading light in the Midsomer Conservation Society suspects her neighbours are involved in a money-making development scam. Political wrangling, burglaries and sexual liaisons abound in picturesque Great Pelfe - but why is someone driven to start killing? Barnaby and Jones investigate.

programme.title: Fit for Murder
programme.desc: With his birthday approaching, Barnaby reluctantly accompanies Joyce on a spa weekend to Swavely Manor, but as he attempts to relax, a woman is found dead in the flotation chamber. Abandoning the treatment to investigate, Barnaby uncovers a feud between neighbours, money wrangles and the mystery of a half-written novel. After another gruesome discovery, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: Blood Wedding
programme.desc: There are two contrasting weddings taking place in Midsomer - Cully's to Simon, and local baronet Ned Fitzroy's to Beth Porteous. As Cully suffers from last minute doubts, Barnaby becomes an unwelcome guest at Ned's marriage when the maid of honour is stabbed to death. What are the secrets in Midsomer high society, and will Barnaby get to his daughter's ceremony on time?

programme.title: Shot at Dawn
programme.desc: A family feud dating back to WWI comes to a head after the unveiling of a war memorial in Midsomer Parva, when a retired colonel is found dead. During their investigation, Barnaby and Jones discover that the town's mayor blamed the deceased man for his grandfather's shooting for cowardice at the Somme, and that the dysfunctional families are connected by dangerous secrets.

programme.title: Left for Dead
programme.desc: A reclusive couple are found dead, victims of a supposedly botched burglary which shocks the occupants of the village of Dunstan. Then, a guest is murdered at the wedding at one of Jones' oldest friends. Could this spate of killings be connected to a mystery of a fatal road accident, and the disappearance of a teenager 20 years ago?

programme.title: Midsomer Life
programme.desc: When a body is discovered in woodland near Midsomer Sonning, country magazine Midsomer Life and its outspoken owner Guy Sandys come under scrutiny from Barnaby and Jones. Former city fund manager Guy is disliked in the neighbourhood for his negative reviews of local businesses. The body proves to be that of a man with whom Guy's wife was having an affair. Then Guy himself is found stabbed through the heart.

programme.title: Murder by Magic
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: Days of Misrule
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are called away from a hated team-building exercise to investigate an explosion at a haulage yard run by Territorial Army officer Matt Parkes and his ruthless son James. James is involved in some shady activities, but is he capable of arson or murder? When a body turns up, there are plenty of other suspects on the scene, including a peace protestor and a host of trained killers at the TA.

programme.title: Talking to the Dead
programme.desc: Two couples vanish without trace from the village of Monks Barton amid rumours of witchcraft and haunted woods. Flamboyant psychic Cyrus LeVanu clashes with pompous cleric Wallace Stone as a body is found, while other villagers seem to be caught up in a stolen antiques racket.

programme.title: The Green Man
programme.desc: An accident during the restoration of a canal leads to a particularly difficult case for Barnaby and Troy, which appears to be linked to a group of rowdy teenagers.

programme.title: Bad Tidings
programme.desc: Sergeant Dan Scott arrives to work with Barnaby and is thrown straight into a murder investigation in Midsomer Mallow. A noise heard near the scene of Fiona Thompson's bloodstained body leads police to suspect an odd-job man, but when the murder toll rises, Barnaby becomes concerned for Cully, who is organising a ten-year school reunion.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Womanising landowner Gareth Heldman is killed by a violent blow from a Celtic spear, reawakening memories of a tragic archaeological dig at the ancient mound of Midsomer Barrow.

programme.title: Sins of Commission
programme.desc: When a prize-winning author is murdered on the eve of a literary festival, Barnaby and Scott discover a hotbed of corruption, scandal and financial mismanagement in the community of Midsomer St Michael. Before they can discover who is telling the truth, the death toll begins to rise.

programme.title: The Maid in Splendour
programme.desc: When a young barman from The Maid in Splendour pub is found shot dead, Barnaby and Scott uncover a web of romantic intrigue involving several members of the bar staff.

programme.title: The Straw Woman
programme.desc: The revival of a traditional festival at Midsomer Parva ends in tragedy when the curate, the Rev Alex Dakin, is burnt alive inside a straw effigy of a woman. Then his gay lover the priest, the Rev Jim Hale, dies too.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Labyrinth Lodge in Liverpool in the UK is a haunted house in a cemetery. Originally it was a register office, recording births, deaths and marriages. But it seems some previous residents just don't want to leave. Paranormal investigator Jayne Harris is on hand to capture proof for current owners Sean and Bex, who are hoping to understand more about the strange goings on in their home.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted be previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house in the 1970's and 80s which was believed to have been the site of a fatal fire years earlier. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: The Haunted Castle
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits.

programme.title: Haunted and Cursed Magpie Mines
programme.desc: Haunted Magpie Mines are located in the Peak District of Derbyshire. Believed to be one of the most paranormal mines in the UK. Ghost Dimension investigate claims of paranormal activity and a curse that has been set on to the land. Will a ghost be caught on camera? and will any of the paranormal equipment make contact with the spirit world?

programme.title: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking classes.

programme.title: The Haunted Mill Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mil, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, is now haunted by shadow figures and they appear to want to make themselves known.

programme.title: The Night Before the Storm
programme.desc: In this special episode, its the night before Sean and Bex are joined by their celebrity guest and they checkout The Black Horse in Pluckley Village to investigate the paranormal hauntings at the most haunted pub in the UK.

programme.title: Haunted Weir Mill
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team visit Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport. Dating back to 1790 this mill has seen accidents, suicides, murder and even occult practices. Will the team encounter the spirits or friendly, benevolent children or something darker and more malevolent that lurks within the maze?

programme.title: An Unexpected Haunted Adventure
programme.desc: The team head to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting. With hidden priest holes and a building being reclaimed by the land. Be prepared for one of the scariest investigations ever.

programme.title: Witches and Vampires Haunting Saint James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings. Will the team survive the night unscathed? Will they encounter witchcraft or a vampire that is believed to roam the grounds to this very day?

programme.title: The Wheatsheaf Horror
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: Field of Ghosts
programme.desc: Markie Beason has always sensed spirits in her home, but her family dismisses her fears-until the ghosts shift their focus to her. As the terrifying encounters intensify, Markie grows desperate for answers. When her father finally believes her, he calls in paranormal investigators to uncover the spirits' identities and help bring peace to their haunted home.

programme.title: Angels and Demons
programme.desc: When a demon haunts the home of Maryland single Mom Kathie Sheats , psychics, priests and paranormal investigators fail to resolve the issue. Only Kathie herself can conquer the dark entity ... with the help of an angel.

programme.title: Blood Visions
programme.desc: The Johnson family has found what they consider their perfect home in Michigan. But it turns out to be haunted, and a demon targets their son for possession. Only the power of prayer can restore peace and sanity.

programme.title: The Haunted Victorian
programme.desc: Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero move into a dream Victorian home, but eerie footsteps and slamming doors soon plague them. When Edwin sees a full-body apparition, they seek help. Lillian's behavior darkens as an evil female spirit possesses her. She suffers physical attacks in her sleep, and as the hauntings escalate, they realize escaping may no longer be an option.

programme.title: Vision of Terror
programme.desc: After losing her husband in a tragic accident, Stacy Stowe hears ghostly sounds and assumes it's his spirit-until her daughter insists it's something evil. Dark figures prowl the home, and attacks escalate. A paranormal cleanser brings temporary peace, but a new psychic warns that unless Stacy closes the portal, the evil will never leave.

programme.title: Spirits of the Dead
programme.desc: Joanne and Jim Whitley's dream of running a horse-riding business turns into a nightmare when strange occurrences plague their New Hampshire farm. Their son hears eerie sounds, and Joanne senses a dark presence. As financial struggles mount, their horses fall mysteriously ill. When the spirit turns violent and threatens their child, Joanne calls on a Shamballa master to fight the evil force.

programme.title: The Demon's Revenge
programme.desc: Tiffany McKinnon, Billy Quattlebaum, and his daughter move into a 200-year-old farmhouse in Franklin, VA. While Tiffany tries to make peace with a lingering spirit, a darker entity lurks in the shadows, tormenting the family. Determined to stay, Tiffany seeks help from paranormal investigators and the church, hoping to expel the evil before it destroys their lives.

programme.title: Wicked Eviction
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, a single mother of three, relocates her family for a fresh start but her dream turns to a nightmare when her family is antagonized by multiple entities. Desperate, Tammy finds a paranormal team who reveal the true evil in the home.

programme.title: Hungry Ghosts
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. When an American family moves into a lavish mansion in the Yangmingshan Mountains, they witness disturbing supernatural events. Skeptical at first, they refuse to believe in ghosts-until their youngest daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest reveals the house was designed to empower the dead and torment the living.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: After Linda returns from India, her daughter Kara experiences terrifying events, convinced their home is haunted. Linda dismisses it-until she has her own chilling encounter. Realizing Kara was right, they turn to a clairvoyant for answers. As the truth of their haunting unravels, they must find a way to confront the unknown before it takes hold of their lives.

programme.title: Where Evil Lurks
programme.desc: The Shea family's Arkansas home seems peaceful until eerie voices and ghostly noises shatter the quiet. Believing it's the spirit of a young boy who died there, they feel at ease until a darker entity emerges, bringing terror. When one of their children suffers a serious injury, they fear the spirit is to blame. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to psychic mediums to confront the evil.

programme.title: Ghostly Voices
programme.desc: Angelina believes her home's ghost is harmless, but when her daughter starts hearing eerie voices, doubt creeps in. Medical tests reveal nothing, leading her parents to fear a supernatural cause. Desperate for answers, they seek help from a priest and a medium, who uncover a troubled spirit in need of peace-one that must be confronted before their daughter's fate is sealed.

programme.title: Nightmare Upstairs
programme.desc: Dream House When the VanLandingham family moves into an Arkansas home, their young daughters become the target of a supernatural attack by dark entities. After fruitless efforts by a Pastor and paranormal investigator, they decide to abandon their 'dream house' forever.

programme.title: The Haunting of Allen House
programme.desc: The historic Allen House in Arkansas is haunted. Mark and Rebecca Spencer knew it when they bought it. They investigate the cause of the haunting, discover the home's secret past and a previous owner who committed suicide.

programme.title: Legend Trippers
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: Evil Rises
programme.desc: While recovering from surgery, Jacinda Rearick notices orbs in photos, believing them to be her late parents. But when her son sees a dark entity and shadowy tentacles attack her, she realizes something sinister has invaded their home. As the entity grows more violent, Jacinda turns to local investigators, desperate to rid her house of the encroaching evil.

programme.title: Ghost Confessions
programme.desc: The Sherman family's dream life turns into a nightmare when 17-year-old Macy is targeted by a terrifying entity. As her mother and sister experience paranormal activity, their skeptical father remains unconvinced-until he hears an unseen presence speak. With the spirit refusing to leave, the desperate family turns to experts for help before it's too late.

programme.title: Demons Never Die
programme.desc: After moving to the suburbs, Bill and Amanda Toler dismiss eerie noises-until Bill is scratched and Amanda sees an inhuman face. Paranormal investigators uncover a portal in their home and a demon that followed Bill from his job at a penitentiary. In a race against time, they must close the portal and banish the entity before it destroys the family.

programme.title: House of Sorrows
programme.desc: Darrin and Jamie Shriver move into a home where four people died of CO poisoning. Strange sounds and ghostly sightings soon turn sinister-Darrin and their dog are attacked. Paranormal investigators cleanse the home, but Darrin unknowingly invites dark forces back, putting his wife and newborn in grave danger. Can they escape the house's tragic fate?

programme.title: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Strange occurrences in Charles Gonzales' home awaken memories of past paranormal events tied to his uncle's unsolved murder. Seeking answers, he contacts psychic Desiree Page, who warns of a deadly family curse. When a vengeful spirit attacks Charles and his girlfriend, he must confront childhood memories and uncover hidden truths before the entity traps him forever.

programme.title: Love Curse
programme.desc: For years, a dark force stalks Lee Moore in his nightmares. After he and his bride Claire move into their first home, the entity emerges, attacking Claire while she's pregnant. A ghost hunter confirms it's a demon, and experts cleanse the home. But when the hunter returns for an uninvited ritual, Lee falls mysteriously ill. Can demonologists save him before the entity claims his soul?

programme.title: Dark Wrath
programme.desc: Cindy's recurring nightmares of a dark, angry figure intensify as she moves her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Assuming it's just stress, she pushes forward, but soon, her dreams become reality. Her daughters fear their room, and an eerie presence lurks in the shadows. When the entity physically attacks her, Cindy must summon her courage to fight the evil before it harms her family.

programme.title: Demon's Lair
programme.desc: The Cranmer family believes their historic Pittsburgh home is haunted by a harmless ghost-until the activity turns violent. Seeking help from the Catholic Church, they uncover a demon and the home's dark past. As attacks escalate and walls ooze a blood-like substance, they refuse to flee, facing a terrifying battle that culminates in a desperate exorcism.

programme.title: Monster in the Apartment
programme.desc: Morgan Knudson and her friend Bob move into a downtown Edmonton flat, only to discover a dark spirit lurking. While Bob, battling cancer and loneliness, sees a harmless ghostly boy, Morgan senses something sinister. When the entity violently attacks her, she seeks a demonologist who reveals the truth-the spirit is trying to possess Bob, and Morgan must act before it claims his soul.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Randy and Marcy, both in law enforcement, face mounting stress when their son is deployed overseas. Marcy's overwhelming fear awakens a dormant spirit that feeds on her anxiety, growing dangerously powerful. As the presence tightens its grip, Marcy must stay calm and find a way to banish the evil force before it drives her to the brink.

programme.title: Gateway To Evil
programme.desc: Devastated by a friend's murder, Julisa holds a séance to communicate one last time--and unwittingly invites a dark spirit into her home...and her life. Julisa and her mother believe that she has re-ignited the evil that plagued her mother years ago.

programme.title: The Possessed
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: Ghost Protector
programme.desc: A mother and daughter both believe their house is haunted. But while the mother believes it's the spirit of her murdered boyfriend, her daughter believes it's much darker. After paranormal experts investigate they uncover an epic battle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic Connecticut restaurant, only to be overwhelmed by forces of evil when employees and patrons are attacked. Investigators, mediums and clairvoyants are called in to rid the restaurant of its demonic past.

programme.title: Curse of the Mummy
programme.desc: After a chilling encounter at an Egyptian exhibit, Caleb Weaver is haunted by a relentless entity. Years of torment force him to flee, but when he returns home, the dark force reawakens-stronger than ever. Now, it seeks to possess him and threatens those he loves. With time running out, Caleb turns to a deliverance minister for a final battle against the ancient evil seeking his soul.

programme.title: Mother's Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette's firefighter husband dies, she moves her daughters to a Long Island hamlet for a fresh start. But eerie discoveries and violent paranormal attacks turn their refuge into a nightmare. Determined to fight back, Jeanette enlists a psychic to uncover the home's dark past and a deliverance minister to confront the relentless evil threatening her family's safety.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Sandra Waldron is fascinated by the supernatural, but her son Gene wants no part of it. When they learn their home is haunted, Sandra dives deeper into the paranormal, eventually embracing Wicca. Seeking good fortune, she unknowingly opens a portal to evil. With Gene gone in the military, Sandra must now battle the dark force she unleashed before it consumes her entirely.

programme.title: Echoes of the Past
programme.desc: Libby and Sean Johnson renovate a Vermont home, unaware of its tragic past. Soon, eerie noises fill the night, and their daughter speaks of visiting 'fairies.' As they uncover the home's dark history, ghostly activity escalates to physical attacks. Desperate for answers, Libby turns to paranormal investigators, hoping they can rid the house of restless spirits before it's too late.

programme.title: Echoes from the Grave
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Rebecca's new marriage to Daniel seems perfect, but she hides a lifelong secret-she can see and hear spirits. She has always blocked them out, but when a persistent ghost refuses to be ignored, she can no longer run. Forced to confront the entity, Rebecca must trust Daniel and enlist his help to uncover the truth before it threatens their new life together.

programme.title: The Shadowman
programme.desc: As kids, Tim and Tom Yancey love playing in the Florida woods-until a menacing presence begins watching them. When it invades their bedroom, terror traps them in their own home. With no help in sight, the nightmare follows Tim into adulthood. Decades later, he returns to confront the demon that stole his childhood, determined to reclaim his life once and for all.

programme.title: The Presence
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Cindy Sauer
programme.desc: Deadly Attachment Georgia single Mom Cindy Sauer tries to get over the sudden death of her husband when dark shadows and nightmares convince her that a demon is haunting her and her family. Cindy turns to a Pastor to exorcise the entity before it drives them literally insane.

programme.title: A Haunting in Florida
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: Deaths Door
programme.desc: Victoria Dane of New Mexico awakens from a near-­death experience to discover she is being attacked by a dark, demonic entity. With the help of investigators, she soon realizes she has opened a door to a paranormal world that may never be shut.

programme.title: When the Lights Go Out
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits - one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: After marrying Stephen, Angela's childhood nightmares return-only now, the old hag from her dreams appears in waking life. She dismisses it as anxiety until the entity terrorizes her daughter and briefly possesses her son. Realizing the threat is real, Angela, at Stephen's urging, turns to paranormal investigators to fight the relentless evil before it destroys their family.

programme.title: Stalked by Evil
programme.desc: Judy McCarthy hopes for a fresh start in Texas, but a shadowy presence emerges in their home. It fixates on her teenage daughter, Caressa, tormenting her each night. As the entity grows stronger, Judy fights to protect her family. When she uncovers the home's violent past, she realizes the spirit is intent on keeping Caressa trapped-and she must act before it's too late.

programme.title: Hell House
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. After unseen entities attack her children, they seek out psychic investigators. As events grow violent, Bonnie forms a psychic link to the past, and investigators witness the haunting escalate from obsession to possession.

programme.title: House of the Dead
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: The Attic
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: The Unleashed
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: Darkness Follows
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: Shape of Evil
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: Phantom Room
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: Conjuring Evil
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy's peaceful Alaskan retreat turns into a nightmare when their daughter unknowingly invites a dark entity through witchcraft. What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: Hidden Terror
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: Masks of Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: The Diabolical
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: Demon Unearthed
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: Semifinals 2
programme.desc: The semifinals continue as competitors face up to 10 obstacles, including the new obstacle Padlock; for Split Decision, the ninjas must choose between an upper-body and balance obstacle; the top two runs of the night face off on the Power Tower.

programme.title: Semifinals 3

programme.title: Semifinals 4
programme.desc: The semifinals conclude in Los Angeles as competing ninjas face up to 10 challenging obstacles; for Split Decision, ninjas must choose between an upper body and balance obstacle; the top two runs of the night will face off in the Power Tower.

programme.title: National Finals 2
programme.desc: The finals continue in Las Vegas, where the competitors face up to eight supersized obstacles on Stage 1, including Split Decision, where the ninjas much choose between an upper body obstacle or a balance obstacle, in hopes of advancing to Stage 2.

programme.title: National Finals 3

programme.title: The Jerusalem of David and Solomon
programme.desc: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.

programme.title: The New Testament-An Overview
programme.desc: The course begins by addressing some of the basic facts about the New Testament; which books it contains, when they are written, in what language and by whom.

programme.title: Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
programme.desc: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament.

programme.title: The Pauline Epistles
programme.desc: This lecture looks at some of the major teachings of Paul's Epistles; showing how he shapes his theological and ethical views in light of the problems that emerge in his burgeoning Christian communities.

programme.title: The Problem of Pseudonymity
programme.desc: This lecture considers the broad problem of pseudonymity, or forgery, in the ancient world; applying one's findings to the Pauline letters of the New Testament to see if any, in fact, are written by Paul's followers rather than Paul himself.

programme.title: Uncovering Near Eastern Civilization
programme.desc: Egypt, Greece and Rome may be better known to the public; more written evidence survives from Mesopotamia; embarking on a journey through over 3,000 years of history; learning why Mesopotamia's rediscovery is so valuable.

programme.title: Natufian Villagers and Early Settlements
programme.desc: The enormous value of plant and animal domestication; the theories about the transition from a hunter-gatherer lifestyle to agriculture; the challenges that farming presents; a perspective on the cultural sophistication of pre-agrarian peoples.

programme.title: Neolithic Farming, Trading, and Pottery
programme.desc: Travel is dangerous but people transport valuable goods, perhaps via chains of merchants; daily life in Neolithic Mesopotamia, where homes and villages reflect a simple society; evidence of intricate pottery shows that people care about aesthetics.

programme.title: Eridu and Other Towns in the Ubaid Period
programme.desc: The Ubaid people construct monumental buildings, standardize some measurements and must have some sort of formal leadership to care for and control their populations; the people of the Ubaid coordinate their efforts to develop irrigation systems.

programme.title: From Camels to Stars in the Middle East
programme.desc: One of the most important yet overlooked periods in human history; the who, what, why, where, when and how of the Golden Age of Islamic Civilization; exploring the Abbasid Empire; how it bridged the ancient world and the Renaissance.

programme.title: Ibn Battuta's Search for Knowledge
programme.desc: Meeting the Moroccan wayfarer Ibn Battuta; tracing his journey across Northern Africa and the Middle East in the century after the Mongol sack of Baghdad; new insights into the era, including whether it ever truly come to an end.

programme.title: Arabian Nights Caliph: Harun al-Rashid
programme.desc: Getting to know Caliph Harun al-Rashid; Baghdad's House of Wisdom, which is the largest depository of books in the world at the time; it serves as the engine that drives much of the Golden Age; the Arabian Nights collection of stories and legends.

programme.title: The Arab World's Greatest Writer: al-Jahiz
programme.desc: Considered by many scholars to be the finest writer of Arabic prose to ever live, Al-Jahiz is a stylist and author of more than 200 works, uncovering the origins of Arabic writing and documenting the life and works of Al-Jahiz.

programme.title: The Land of Canaan
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Arrival of the Israelites
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City

programme.desc: Getting to know Caliph Harun al-Rashid; Baghdad's House of Wisdom, which is the largest depository of books in the world at the time; it serves as the engine that drives much of the Golden Age; the Arabian Nights collection of stories and legends.

programme.title: The Arab World's Greatest Writer: al-Jahiz
programme.desc: Considered by many scholars to be the finest writer of Arabic prose to ever live, Al-Jahiz is a stylist and author of more than 200 works, uncovering the origins of Arabic writing and documenting the life and works of Al-Jahiz.

programme.title: The Land of Canaan
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Arrival of the Israelites
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City
programme.desc: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish.

programme.title: The Jerusalem of David and Solomon
programme.desc: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.

programme.title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.

programme.title: Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
programme.desc: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature.

programme.title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
programme.desc: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity.

programme.title: Egyptian Gods of Creation
programme.desc: Take account of funerary texts that contain allusions to the ancient Egyptian conceptions of creation.

programme.title: Egyptian Approaches to Creation
programme.desc: Within ancient Egyptian culture, explore the means by which the gods created the world and humanity.

programme.title: The Storm God's Supremacy in the Baal Cycle
programme.desc: This ancient Syrian text, though it lacks an overt description of creation, resonates with key themes of other creation stories of the ancient Near East.

programme.title: Hittite Creation in the Kumarbi Cycle
programme.desc: Here, encounter the Hurrians and Hittites, two lesser known but important peoples of the ancient Near East.

programme.title: A Meditation on Empire
programme.desc: What makes a true "empire"; how empires rise and flourish; how they decline and fall; discovering pointed answers to these and other fundamental questions about the study of empires.

programme.title: Lands, Seas, and Sources
programme.desc: The geography of the ancient Near East plays a decisive role in the region's fascinating empires; looking at the kinds of archeological and documentary evidence like discoveries from excavations of ancient sites help in understanding the period.

programme.title: Sargon and the Dawn of Empire
programme.desc: Charting the rise and the eventual fall of the Akkadian Empire, established by Sargon and strengthened by his grandson, Naram-Sin; learning how they forged the administrative pattern that future Mesopotamian empires follow, pivoting the king.

programme.title: The Third Dynasty of Ur
programme.desc: Professor Dise discusses the brief rise and the eventual disintegration of the imperial dynasty of Ur III in Sumer in the late 22nd century B.C., analyzing how the dynasty's ruler Ur-Nammu introduced tyrannical taxes and economic systems.

programme.title: The Empire of Hammurabi
programme.desc: King Hammurabi fills in the power vacuum left in Mesopotamia after Ur III; establishing the First Dynasty of Babylon, he administers rule through a detailed code of law; the First Dynasty swiftly collapses after Hammurabi's death.

programme.title: Mitanni and the Kassites
programme.desc: Investigating the histories of two Mesopotamian empires that emerged after the First Dynasty of Babylon; the Mitanni of the north follows a decentralized state, like a feudal society; the Kassites in the south bring about socio-economic changes.

programme.title: The Rise of Hatti
programme.desc: The first Near Eastern empire expanding beyond the river valleys of the Nile and Mesopotamia is Hatti, the Hittite kingdom. It originated in the early second millennium B.C. Anatolia, facing crises that threatened its stability.

programme.title: The Government of Hatti
programme.desc: Focusing on the elements of the Hittite government and paying particular attention to the central role played by the Great King in judicial matters, Hatti's intricate imperial system blends hierarchy, bureaucracy and feudalism.
