programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
programme.desc: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

programme.title: La retirada de Casillas
programme.desc: Todos coinciden en Tenerife. Aurelio, la Madame y Alí, la Marina de España, la DEA y la Interpol. Hay nervios, pero Casillas sabe cómo rescatar las 30 toneladas de droga incautadas.

programme.title: Treinta toneladas lo valen
programme.desc: Aurelio convence a Niñón de que financie la renta de los aviones necesarios en España, para así recuperar el cargamento incautado.

programme.title: El secuestro
programme.desc: Tony y Mónica hacen negocios con Doble 30 y piensan dejar a Ninón fuera. También planean el secuestro de su hijo. Le dieron instrucciones a Alí para proceder con el ataque.

programme.title: Casillas al rescate
programme.desc: Ninón le pide a Aurelio que la ayude a encontrar a su hijo, secuestrado por orden de Tony Pastrana. Aurelio la apoya y le promete que lo van a encontrar con vida. El español juega sucio.

programme.title: Sicariato
programme.desc: Omar disminuye los rumores de que El Señor de los Cielos está vivo. Paloma escapa de la casa presidencial. El primer mandatario le encarga a Casillas una macabra misión contra ella.

programme.title: El coraje de Ninón
programme.desc: Ninón llega al sitio donde tienen secuestrado a su hijo y, momentáneamente, le arruina el operativo de rescate a Aurelio. Casillas le pide a Dalvio que le haga un favor al presidente.

programme.title: Casillas y sus dos batallas
programme.desc: En Marsella, Aurelio toma la iniciativa de atacar a Filemón y a los secuestradores de Leonardo. Alguien resulta herido. Colón y su equipo se enteran de que se están robando la droga decomisada.

programme.title: Arrasan con todo
programme.desc: Ismael, Raymundo, Chatarrero y sus secuaces recuperan toda la droga. La ubican en las naves robadas y la distribuyen. Dejan muchos muertos a su paso. Ninon revela su secreto a Casillas.

programme.title: El poder del billete
programme.desc: Mónica convence al presidente para que le conceda una audiencia a Pastrana. El español le propone a Terán una vida paradisíaca en el exilio, haciéndose doblemente millonario, pero con una condición.

programme.title: Amante incrédulo
programme.desc: Ahora que Casillas tocó el corazón de Niñón quiere saber la verdad, si ella mandó a matar a Pilar. Ella insiste en que no lo hizo, pero él no le cree. Rutila se niega a buscar al Chema.

programme.title: Presidente sin escrúpulos
programme.desc: Paloma sufre un paro cardíaco y Omar piensa que murió, pero el médico le informa que la pudieron revivir. Cuando ella reacciona y le pregunta por qué la quiso matar, el presidente desata su ira.

programme.title: El blanco es Esperanza
programme.desc: Salvio y sus hombres encuentran a Esperanza, Aurelio ordena que la eliminen. Aunque Salvio no quiere atacar, Skinny dice que deberían hacerlo. Empieza el tiroteo. Hay varias bajas.

programme.title: ¿Infiltrados?
programme.desc: Juan Carlos llega a la casa de Aurelio y él se sorprende. Ismael se entera de que el padre de Esperanza logró dar con ellos. Casillas quiere saber cómo lo hizo. Javi anhela un hijo con Rutila.

programme.title: Oídos sordos
programme.desc: Juan Carlos le explica a Aurelio cómo llegó hasta él y Casillas trata de saber si le dice la verdad. Salvatierra propone pagar por el rescate de Esperanza. Mientras hablan, secuestran a Pina.

programme.title: La próxima víctima
programme.desc: Aurelio hace un recuento de todos los muertos que lleva en su conciencia. Cree que llegó la hora de deshacerse de alguien más. Por su traición, ahora Mónica teme que Casillas le quite a Isidro.

programme.title: Casillas se queda con Isidro
programme.desc: Tras ser descubierta la casa de seguridad, Aurelio ordena evacuarla. Mónica trata de llevarse a Isidro con ella, pero es detenida por Ninón; ambas discuten. Robles es forzada a dejar al niño.

programme.title: Sin piedad
programme.desc: Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Terán lo compromete.

programme.title: El momento de la verdad
programme.desc: Aurelio y sus secuaces observan a Tony y Esperanza. Casillas lleva a Pina y a Juan Carlos para el intercambio por su hija e ignora sus súplicas. Castillo y Colón van al punto de la negociación.

programme.title: Casillas gana otra vez
programme.desc: Salvatierra y Salazar llegan en helicóptero a rescatar a Esperanza, pero algo sale mal. Mónica termina su relación con Pastrana y jura acabar con Ninón, con tal de recuperar a su hijo, Isidro.

programme.title: Caen en la trampa
programme.desc: Javier y Rutila se enteran del plan de los colombianos, de no venderle más coca a los mexicanos y son encerrados por Quezada. Pretenden deshacerse de ellos. Leandro quiere una alianza con Tony.

programme.title: Al rescate de Rutila
programme.desc: Aurelio viaja a Colombia para intentar rescatar a Rutila. Tony llega y reconoce a Javi. Por otro lado, se acercan la Felina y Raymundo. La casa de Leandro Quezada está rodeada.

programme.title: La sombra de la muerte
programme.desc: Pastrana está en manos de Aurelio, después que Eunice lo entregara a cambio de Ninón. Como cazador a su presa, Casillas y Skinny lo persiguen. A sangre y fuego, la muerte rodea a todos.

programme.title: A la caza de Aurelio Casillas
programme.desc: El Cabo y sus aliados del narcotráfico regresan para ser dueños del negocio y acabar con Casillas y todos los integrantes de su familia. Hieren a Ismael y Javier es víctima de un atentado.

programme.title: Casillas declara la guerra
programme.desc: En cadena nacional, Aurelio Casillas desafía a los narcos de Colombia y deja mal parado al presidente. Se escabulle en medio de un operativo policial. Corina le revela que es de la DEA.

programme.title: Casillas encierra a su amante
programme.desc: La agente especial de la DEA le asegura a Casillas que no lo vendió y está dispuesta a dar su vida por él; pero Aurelio no le cree. Javi despierta, desmemoriado. Quezada prepara su venganza.

programme.title: Atacan a Casillas y a Rutila
programme.desc: Llega la hora de la venganza y Leandro Quezada tiene la oportunidad de deshacerse de El Señor de Los Cielos y de su hija. El Cabo ordena a Jaime conseguirle una cita con el presidente.

programme.title: Casillas y Cabo crean alianzas
programme.desc: El negocio del narcotráfico se mueve rápido: Casillas coquetea con Maldonado en la selva y el Cabo soborna al jefe del estado mayor de México. Buscan extraditar a Aurelio y al presidente.

programme.title: Bloquean a Casillas
programme.desc: Las narcotienditas se quedan sin mercancía y Casillas no tiene cómo conseguirla. El Cabo triunfa en el negocio y jura sacarlo de la jugada. Aurelio hace el amor con Corina.

programme.title: Casillas contra el Cabo
programme.desc: Narcos mexicanos y colombianos luchan por el dominio del territorio y la sangre corre por las calles. Aurelio mata a un policía y el Cabo ordena atropellar al Mocho para evitar que hable.

programme.title: Corina prueba su lealtad
programme.desc: Casillas recibe la ubicación del Secretario de Seguridad, Castillo, en bandeja de plata, tal como Corina se lo prometió. El Cabo niega la alianza de Quezada. Quiere al pez gordo solo para él.

programme.title: Casillas secuestra a Castillo
programme.desc: Casillas y sus hombres raptan a Castillo y lo liberan, con la condición de que encarcele al presidente de México. Zuleta chantajea a Terán y logra que acepte la junta con el Cabo.

programme.title: Todos en contra de Casillas
programme.desc: El Cabo y el presidente pactan eliminar a Casillas. Terán obtendrá votos y control de los carteles y el Cabo su venganza. Zuleta mintió y queda en evidencia.

programme.title: Casillas tiene nueva conquista
programme.desc: Rumbo a Turquía, Casillas y Ámbar Maldonado van por negocios y desatan el juego de la seducción: el Águila blanca debe sacar el demonio que ella lleva por dentro. Corina está celosa.

programme.title: Quezada destrona al Cabo
programme.desc: Quezada y sus hombres matan a sangre fría a los lugartenientes del Cabo y se quedan a cargo de un laboratorio, dejándole claro con quién debe negociar. Casillas y Ámbar pasean, como enamorados.

programme.title: Casillas en el infierno turco
programme.desc: Con una verdadera demostración de fuerza y dominio de las armas, Casillas y Maldonado huyen de los turcos en el camión de oro venezolano.

programme.title: Aurelio saca su lado oscuro
programme.desc: Para no perjudicar su campaña, el padre de Jaime le pide a Omar que, por favor, se aleje de su hijo. Corina le dice a Aurelio que la muerte de Quezada fue una farsa.

programme.title: Aurelio se molesta con Ambar
programme.desc: Casillas desconfía de Ámbar al leer una nota en la que lo cita en el muelle y se excusa por un asunto urgente. Un turco pasará las tres toneladas de oro.

programme.title: Ambar sorprende a Casillas
programme.desc: Casillas amenaza a Ámbar con lanzarla del avión, pero ella trae consigo un detonador nuclear. Rutila halla una pista de Javi en la selva. Quezada consigue a su doble para despistar al enemigo.

programme.title: Aurelio y Ambar, tal para cual
programme.desc: Aurelio y Ámbar son de la misma especie, hacen negocios por la adrenalina y el gozo que les produce; no por dinero. La DEA cae en la trampa de Quezada, llega al laboratorio, pero es un señuelo.

programme.title: Acorralan a Casillas
programme.desc: Quezada mantiene su mentira con alfileres, exige la complicidad de El Cabo y el silencio a la guerrilla para engañar a Casillas. Navarro felicita a Corina, pero aún desconfía de su lealtad.

programme.title: Aurelio amenaza a la guerrilla
programme.desc: En Colombia, Aurelio increpa a los guerrilleros para que le digan la verdad, luego que Corina le informa que la muerte de Quezada puede tratarse de una farsa. Javi, oculto, ve a Rutila.

programme.title: La DEA tras El Cabo
programme.desc: Castillo toma una foto de Milton Jiménez y la comparte con los jefes como parte del plan para acabar con el narcotráfico. Kashi le miente a Milena. Ámbar entrega el detonador a los terroristas.

programme.title: Aurelio llega a Cuba
programme.desc: El señor de los cielos se salta a los subalternos y exige ver al que mueve los hilos en La Habana para aclarar asuntos de producción y jerarquía en los negocios. El Cabo tiene un soplón.

programme.title: Casillas provoca al diablo
programme.desc: Aurelio deja en claro que él manda en el negocio y reta a Valdés, segundo al mando de la Revolución cubana, a que se pronuncie. Recibe silencio por respuesta. Casasola interviene para conciliar.

programme.title: El Cabo se enamora
programme.desc: Milton Jiménez queda deslumbrado con la belleza de Evelina, la prometida del Pastor Felipe, por quien se deshace en halagos y le da una jugosa limosna. Casillas huye de Cuba y arrestan a Ámbar.

programme.title: El Cabo al descubierto
programme.desc: Casillas alista una lluvia de plomazos contra el Cabo, luego de enterarse de que es el responsable de los ataques a su familia en Veracruz y otros atentados. Rutila trata de asociarse con su padre.

programme.title: Rutila se entera que Javi vive
programme.desc: Para borrar sus penas, Rutila va a la cama con El Dasa, pero luego se entera de que Superjavi no murió. El Cabo mata a El Pastor, para quedarse con Evelina. Castillo le pone el ojo a Zuleta.

programme.title: Rutila se reencuentra con Javi
programme.desc: Tras conocer la buena noticia, Rutila llora de emoción y viaja a Colombia para abrazar a Superjavi. El Cabo consuela a la viuda, Evelina. Valdés presiona a Ámbar con el oro, o va al calabozo.

programme.title: El Cabo roba terreno a Aurelio
programme.desc: Casillas descubre que el presidente protege al Cabo. Mientras, el colombiano ejecuta a sus hombres y le roba espacios al Señor de los cielos. La DEA va contra Zuleta.

programme.title: Rutila seduce a Super Javi

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Coming Soon
programme.desc: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
programme.desc: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

programme.desc: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.title: Backtrack
programme.desc: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: Freeway
programme.desc: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.

Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: Chapter 13: Ball Flight Commander

programme.title: Chapter 14: The Open
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots made famous by Open Champions at St. Andrews. Learn how to hit powerful draws like Tiger Woods, escape the rough like Seve Ballesteros, and stick wedges like John Daly.

programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to maximize power like the game's longest drivers. Martin explains how baseball and boxing can translate into a more powerful golf swing.

programme.title: Chapter 16: Right or Rubbish
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the truth behind some of golf's greatest swing myths. Learn how to grip the club properly like Tiger Woods, hit more accurate irons like Padraig Harrington, and use Elvis Presley to add more distance.

programme.title: Chapter 17: Play Like a Champion
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the skills of golf's greatest champions; how to start the downswing like Jack Nicklaus and improve the swing path like Nick Faldo; guest Sophia Popov shares the drill that helped her win the 2020 AIG Women's Open.

programme.title: Chapter 18: Chip It Close
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal demonstrate Dave Pelz's tip to stop hitting the ground before the ball and a shot around the green used by Open champions.

programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach pitching tips from some of golf's greatest champions. Learn how to set up for solid contact like Tiger Woods, hit the flop shot like Raymond Floyd, and spin wedges like Paul Runyan.

programme.title: Chapter 20: Backswing Faults
programme.desc: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal lean on golf's greatest players to cure the biggest backswing faults. Stop excessive leg action like Jack Nicklaus, reduce upper body sway like Arnold Palmer, and improve poor swing plane like Seve Ballesteros.

programme.title: Chapter 21: Copy That Pro
programme.desc: Key parts of the swing golfers should copy from the best players in the world; a backswing move used by Sam Burns; a drill to add distance like Xander Schauffele; a footwork tip that helped Scottie Scheffler.

programme.title: Chapter 22: Need For Speed
programme.desc: How to increase club head speed, ball speed, and other key areas where speed is needed for more distance. Martin Hall brings in one of the worldwide leaders in golf biomechanics for a cutting-edge lesson on practicing at the correct speed.

programme.title: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: Distance control is the focus as contestants learn coming up short can send them packing.

programme.title: Driving Reigns

programme.title: Spell N-E-R-V-E-S

programme.title: Inches Away
programme.desc: Nerves, tension, and bad weather play a game with accuracy and control.

programme.desc: After nine weeks of elimination challenges, only two remain to battle it out in match play for a shot at the LPGA Tour. The two rivals have butted heads throughout the series and the mutual disdain should make this a bitter and competitive round.

programme.desc: Contestants on teams representing the United States and Europe begin their quest to realize a dream and play on golf's grandest stage. Featuring PGA Tour winner Tommy Gainey.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: A rush of national pride consumes the players as they tee it up in their first team, match-play competition to determine who's up for elimination, where it's distance control that determines an unlucky player's fate.

programme.title: Sharpshooters Survive
programme.desc: It's all about accuracy as the contestants test their approach shots and drive for more than just show to stay alive.

programme.title: Flashback Fortunes
programme.desc: Contestants experience déjà vu as they try to earn immunity from elimination, while an unfortunate few battle gusty winds and attempt to get a handle on distance control.

Here he clashes with crime boss, Mason, and his men and manages to escape, but so does Mason.

programme.title: Filthy Guy
programme.desc: Sammo Hung is a poor village orphan called 'Filthy Guy' for his unwashed / diseased head whose ambitious landlord's son becomes king and wants to kill him, as a prophecy predicts Sammo Hung will replace him. Eventually Sammo Hung becomes the first Ming Emperor.

programme.title: Fury in Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: Pak Si-baek, master of the Taekwondo martial arts, and Wang Pa-san, master of the Jeong-mu Taekwondo martial arts, decide to take each other's child and teach them their martial arts styles. But when Si-baek arrives at the Shaolin Buddhist Temple, the Buddhist priest Gong-young of the school of Jeong-Mu has already been kicked out. Si-baek is accused of playing a part in stealing the Shaolin secret manuscripts and imprisoned according to Jeong-mu law. The school of Jeong-mu flourishes.

programme.title: The Ninja Squad
programme.desc: THE MASTER - THE STUDENT - their desperate challenge. Two highly skilled ninjas come together, with two different personal wars. Billy, fresh from ten years of training, is blinded by revenge for the murder of his family... Ninja Gordon needs to defeat a power-hungry ninja, Ivan the Red, before he eliminates everybody in his way. Can both master and student overcome the obstacles put before them? An explosive and grueling duel ensues that determines the fate of the Ninja Empire.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 3
programme.desc: Ittou and Daigoro were eating in a room of an inn in Ushiori when Okaayo jumped in. Upon closer inspection, there was blood on her hands. Okayo had stabbed and killed Bunbematsu, who had attacked her to take her body, by mistake after a struggle, and had entered Itto and the others' room to escape anyway. The brothel manager Torizo could not let her go. He ordered Itto, who was hiding Okayo, to hand her over to him. Ittou, however, refused to comply with his request.

programme.title: Instant Kung Fu Man
programme.desc: Two identical twins, the younger one, a Disciple of Shaolin who's crafty tricks make up for his poor kung fu, and the elder, a vicious bandit with tremendous kung fu skills, cause havoc when they mix their identities to fool the Shaolin monks and a ruthless robber, who are both keen to catch the twins for different reasons.

programme.title: Ninja over the Great Wall
programme.desc: Ninja over the Great Wall takes place in the early nineteen-thirties when China was occupied by the Japanese imperial forces. Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.

programme.title: 52 Masters: FIGHTABILITY with Cole Rogers
programme.desc: Will takes a class with martial artist Cole Rogers, who teaches self-defense for people with disabilities.

programme.title: Raiders of Buddhist Kung Fu
programme.desc: At the turn of the century an ex-official, Nan Kit, conspires to restore the Manchu Dynasty and practices the secret and deadly Buddhist Break Neck Palm to become indestructible. Opposing him is Wong Lung, who must learn the Iron Flowers Shadow Fist from Iron Wu to have any chance of beating this mighty adversary.

programme.title: Shaolin Traitorous
programme.desc: As a child, Yang witnesses the murder of his parents by three kung fu masters. The child patiently waits outside Shaolin until admitted, and is later accepted as a student by an elder monk. Yang has no trouble leaving the temple, ready to find the killers and make mincemeat of them.

programme.title: Ninja: The Final Duel
programme.desc: The Ji Ho Ninja clan vow to destroy the monks of a Shaolin temple. To do so they must first perfect their Water Spider Assault Unit, the Iron Tiger Claw, the Ninja Rock Climbing Formation and the Ninja Heaven Death Wish Blade. Luckily the Shaolin temple finds protection in the form of two Japanese martial monks, a pair of Hare Krishna's and a monk from darkest Africa.

programme.title: Woman Avenger
programme.desc: Kwan was brutally gang raped by the killers of her husband, destitute she finds sanctuary with a nun, who teaches her Dragon style Kung Fu. Armed with this new fighting method, Kwan goes on her vengeance trial dispatching all those that took part in the rape and murder, although she's not a match of the more senior members of the gang. Fortunately, she meets a crippled woman, who also fell victim to the gang, instructs Kwan how to defeat the gang leaders.

programme.title: Image Of Bruce Lee Aka Storming Attacks
programme.desc: A band of counterfeiters wants to make Hong Kong their new territory. The disgraced leader of the Special Squad will have to team-up with a group of Hong Kong police officers in an attempt to stop the dirty business of crime lord Han Tin Lung, but Han's problem not only is the interference of the Police force, his Japanese ally Kimura is not happy with his 'cut' in the counterfeit deal and will try to put Donna (a relative of Han) on his side and make Han's business his own property.

programme.title: Thunder Score
programme.desc: Thai superstar Sorapong Chatree teams up with the Hong Kong "5 Venom" star, Sun Chien to bring down a powerful warlord.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 5
programme.desc: Itto met Genjiro Karube and Chika Osaka, a pair traveling in search of avengers. Four years ago, Senga's husband was killed by Mabuchi Shinpachi in a drunken quarrel. Karube, who knew Mabuchi's face, was ordered by the clan to accompany Senga, who carried a letter of pardon for the avenger. But now, after four years of traveling, he is losing his purpose of fulfilling his true intentions.

programme.title: Equals Against Devils
programme.desc: Champ Wang, Roc Tien and Kor Chun Hung star in this action-packed martial arts spectacular about the satisfying search for revenge. A fighter is brutally beaten and left for dead, but manages to survive ... barely. Time heals, however, even if it doesn't wipe away the harsh memories, and later, strong and determined, the man rises from the proverbial ashes to seek those who've wronged him.

programme.title: Dance of the Drunk Mantis
programme.desc: Rubber legs, the master of Northern Drunken boxing and Mantis fist travels to Canton in search of China's master of Southern Drunken boxing. Sam the Seeds wants to challenge him to a death duel so he can beat the drunken boxer in China. However, Sam the Seeds and adopted son Foggy puts Rubber legs plan into disarray.

programme.title: Ninja American Warrior: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 9
programme.desc: The super-agent Queen Bee returns in another action packed adventure, this time she takes on a ruthless crime lord known as the Shrew.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum: Pioneers of Martial Arts History
programme.desc: The martial arts made a significant impact on American society following World War II. Servicemen such as Robert Trias and Chuck Norris, who studied martial arts in Okinawa and Korea, introduced these disciplines to America and opened their own schools. This video series chronicles the journey of these pioneers, who later became legends in their respective arts. It spotlights unique icons who not only made a name for themselves but also left an enduring mark on American history and the world.

programme.title: 52 Masters: MUAY THAI with Phil Aslaksen
programme.desc: In this episode of 52 Masters, William trains in Muay Thai with Kru Phil Aslaksen. Interview follows in which they discuss martial beginnings, Muay Thai, Dan Inosanto, Chai Sirisute, karate, martial arts in the movies, and more. Enjoy!

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 5
programme.desc: Under the strict rule of the new Shogun, many samurais were suddenly outcast and became Ronins. A group of rogue Ronins kept an inn under hostage in a plot to overthrow the current shogunate.

programme.title: Shaolin Drunken Monk
programme.desc: To avenge his parents, Lao kidnaps the daughter of one of the men who betrayed his father in hope of luring him out. Through the process of defeating his minions, Lao befriends a one-handed fighter out for similar revenge. Meanwhile, the daughter falls in love with Lao. Lao and the one-handed man team-up in a final battle to the death.

programme.title: Iron Ox, the Tiger's Killer
programme.desc: A champion level fighter who's basically overcome all the criminal threats in his area, decides to use his skills to exact his own special brand of vigilante justice against those he blames for the death of his crippled trainer. His girl and others, meanwhile try and convince him to let the law deal with it, but his anger and frustration is so intense he refuses to stop his vigilante ways, no matter what.

programme.title: Fighting Sticks of Arnis
programme.desc: In Fighting Sticks of Arnis we meet many grandmasters who are students of the founder of Modern Arnis, Professor Remy Presas. "I started in Modern Arnis" says grandmaster Rodel Dagooc. "Grandmaster Remy Presas was my godfather. Without him, Arnis would have become a dying art." For martial arts practitioners visiting the Philippines, Luneta Park is the first and last stop.

programme.title: Ninja the Battalion
programme.desc: Four scientists are kidnapped by unscrupulous gangsters of a syndicate who force the scientists to develop a bacteriological warfare program. There are only a few who can deal with the Syndicate! The Ninja-Battalion is committed and is to find the location of the scientists, free them and eradicate the Syndicate. Their relentless opponents are the secret service professionals of the Eastern Powers.

programme.title: Secret Ninja, Roaring Tiger
programme.desc: Dragon Lee stars in this Godfrey Ho epic. Kong, winner of a martial arts contest, his prize, a billionaire's ravishing daughter Susan, is about to begin the most dangerous mission of his life. Susan is kidnapped by a Ninja sect headed by Tiger So. a legendary Ninjitsu master. Dragon can only guess why tiger has taken Susan. The shocking truth begins to dawn, when the final showdown approaches and Ninja violence reaches its fatal peak.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 6
programme.desc: It was raining heavily. With the river overflowing, Itto and Daigoro could not move. Watching the children playing with paper balloons at a rain shelter, Itto remembers a happy past with Daigoro and Azami, his newborn three years ago.

programme.title: Black Dragon
programme.desc: Decent, simple, and honest Chinese farmhand and ace martial artist Tai-Lin go to the Philippines to seek his fortune. He befriends scruffy petty street hoodlum Siao-Mao and gets a job as a dock worker. When Tai-Lin discovers that the people he works for are involved in a crime syndicate that specializes in smuggling opium, he quits his job and joins forces with two fellow martial artists against the evil organization.

programme.title: Kung Fu Karateka
programme.desc: Whilst at the notorious Tokyo Horserace Track, Chu Chin is seen with his girl, Mingse, by three evil gangland figures. One, the dreaded Oy Vin, still loves Mingse, and can't stand to be without her. Cleverly he gets Chu Chin outside the stadium and there, with two thugs, beats him brutally, and then abuses Mingse. Chu Chin has only revenge to live for. How to beat these vicious gangsters and restore his respect in the gang. He takes to the Karateka for help..!

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 9
programme.desc: Itto received an assassination request to kill a feudal lord and was betrayed by a traitor in the clan. Daigoro was ambushed and the two of them got separated. In their times apart from each other they learn more about family bonds and what it means to become a parent.

programme.title: 7 Commandments Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: An Assassin adopts a new disciple from an old Kung Fu master. He teaches him the mantis kung fu in the hope that his new protégé will continue his killing for him. Awesome action follows!

programme.title: Dragon Squad
programme.desc: When a case of gold is stolen in transit, the surviving member of an escort party, Sung (Kam Kong) tries to recover it. He initially turns to Master Wu (Chen Sing) who unfortunately develops a drinking problem after he gets out of prison for accidentally killing someone. He has felt guilty ever since. Wu S friend Hung (Chang Yi) decides to help Sung and enlists a con man, Sau Pau (Jimmy Wang Yu), who has come upon some evidence.

programme.title: Cinema of Vengeance
programme.desc: "Cinema of Vengeance" is an in-depth documentary of the Hong Kong film action industry. Covering broad eras from the early black & white Chinese adventure pictures, to the first real kung fu films:, the golden days of the Shaw Bros. and Golden Harvest studios, the heyday of Bruce Lee, the gangster-influenced era, and finishing out on the time of John Woo's growing international appeal.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 10
programme.desc: The Yagyus are involved in a tragic conflict between the family of a bride and a corrupt government official. A series of manipulations finally led Jubei to confront The shogun himself.

programme.title: Deadly Silver Angels
programme.desc: Two groups of knife-wielding and kicking women in bikinis join forces to kill a gang boss responsible for killing their fathers. But they're not very effective. After three attacks on the culprit, the worst damage he suffered was having his ankle run over by a motorbike. A closer co-operation with a casino boss may help.

programme.title: Kung Fu Rascals
programme.desc: To restore their village to its former glory, the Kung Fu Rascals must go on a quest to find a power most...BIG. The evil Bamboo Man sends out his forces to teach the Rascals a lesson in kung fu etiquette. Who will triumph? Only the Old Wise Guy knows.

programme.title: Ninja Knight - Thunder Fox
programme.desc: You cannot reason with a knife blade or the barrel of a gun...Brad and Bonnie, private detectives, have been hired to crack down an underworld drug and prostitution ring by gangsters Tedder and Tiger. But when girls start turning up dead, both find themselves the targets of ninja assassins. But when Bonnie learns that her sister has been murdered, she unleashes all her ninja fury in a blood bath of revenge.

programme.title: Duel of Flying Kicks
programme.desc: A corrupt mayor of a town in Szechuan province allies himself with a group of bandits to gain control of the region by cutting off all supply routes to the town. Two policemen, both expert kickers are deployed to put an end to the mayor's evil plot.

programme.title: Ninja Phantom Heroes: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 6
programme.desc: A ninja prisoner at a hard labor camp is released when he agrees to accept a mission to take down a criminal organization.

programme.title: To Love and to Cherish
programme.desc: Dog and Beth help Leland capture a fugitive when they should be making plans for their upcoming wedding; tragedy strikes the morning of the event.

programme.title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
programme.desc: Lyssa gets some on-the-job training when she helps Dog hunt a man who ran out on a bond for second-degree assault.

programme.title: In Sickness and in Health
programme.desc: Dog hunts for a fugitive while being as sick as his namesake, then offers some encouraging advice after he eventually nabs his troubled quarry.

programme.title: If the Shirt Fits...
programme.desc: Dog has issues with the shirt that Beth purchased for him; the gang goes after a fugitive who failed to appear in court.

programme.title: The Thief Who Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Dog spends Christmas Day attempting to track down a man who steals to support a drug habit, and hopes to present his quarry with a shiny pair of handcuffs as a holiday gift.

programme.title: Rock-a-Bye Bounty
programme.desc: Dog and Beth's former housekeeper has a new career as a bond-jumper; the eventual capture of their ex-employee turns out to be a bittersweet victory.

programme.title: Father-Hood
programme.desc: Tim spends quality time with his toddler daughter before he goes after a client who failed to show up for court.

programme.title: Cops and Criminals
programme.desc: Dog makes a memorable impression on elementary school students on Career Day; an old friend and sheriff helps Dog track an elusive fugitive with connections in the drug world.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: The team has only a photograph and a relative's address to work with as they pursue a man facing sexual-assault charges.

programme.title: Cupid in Cuffs
programme.desc: The team attempts to draw out a woman who failed to appear in court on theft charges; Dog contacts a jeweler to purchase something special for Beth.

programme.title: Bustin' With Justin
programme.desc: Dog is forced to call in former employee Justin when Duane Lee is sick, but Tim and Leland worry that Justin is not a team player.

programme.title: Bonds of Love
programme.desc: Dog and Beth help Leland capture a fugitive when they should be making plans for their upcoming wedding.

programme.title: Run Fugitive, Run
programme.desc: The team hunts for a fugitive with a history of domestic violence; Beth trains for a 5-kilometer race.

programme.title: Vegas or Bust
programme.desc: Dog tries to clear two cases from his docket before he travels to Las Vegas to give a speech at a convention for professional bail agents.

programme.title: Playing Possum
programme.desc: Tim has big problems on his hands when he learns that a client who failed to appear in court for drug charges is hiding out at his father's family compound.

programme.title: Rainy Day Woman
programme.desc: The team braves bad weather and treks through some of Honolulu's less-desirable locations to capture a woman who failed to appear on a drug charge.

programme.title: Ticket to Ride
programme.desc: Dog decides it's time to get new SUVs for the crew, then breaks in the vehicles by hunting for a woman with an extensive criminal record.

programme.title: Mother Knows Best
programme.desc: Two mothers want to revoke their offspring's bonds as they feel their children will be better off in jail.

programme.title: Irons in the Fire
programme.desc: Dog returns to Denver, and decides the crew should start using pepper-ball guns for better personal protection.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Roundup
programme.desc: Dog helps out two bondsmen buddies whose clients are wanted on charges of drug possession and massive traffic offenses.

programme.desc: Dog takes the crew horseback riding in Denver; Dog helps a bondsman friend track a missing longtime customer.

programme.title: Running on Empty
programme.desc: Dog wants one more capture before he leaves Colorado to return home to Hawaii; a young man trades away his bright future to walk on the dark side.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Dog and a Colorado bondsman track a 6-foot-tall, 240-pound-plus bad boy; the hunt leads the duo to a unique hideout.

programme.title: The Mystery of Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Dog tries to help a young female fugitive who has the same birthdate as his late daughter, Barbara Katy.

programme.desc: Dog continues his legal battle to fight extradition to Mexico in connection with his 2003 capture of fugitive rapist Andrew Luster and questions whether he has the desire to bounty-hunt again.

programme.desc: The team searches for a bail jumper with a history of abusing women; Dog and Beth play "good cop, bad cop" in the hopes of snaring their prey.

programme.desc: Dog searches for a Hawaiian surfer known as "Buttons" who wiped out on the rocky shoals of drug addiction.

programme.desc: Baby Lyssa dons a disguise and heads to the airport to track a bail jumper believed to be returning to Honolulu.

programme.title: Haunted House Of Nuns

programme.desc: On this episode of Paranormal Encounters, Connor and India travel to Winchester, Indiana to investigate the historic Stone Mansion. What they expect to be a quiet night turns into one of the most compelling investigations in a long while as they converse with the other side. They quickly find that what they capture backs up the paranormal claims other visitors have experienced inside this haunted mansion.

programme.title: Un-Rappin'

programme.title: The Ex Factor

programme.title: Baskett Cases

programme.title: A Hero's Call

programme.title: Chillingham Castle

Yard worker, Ray Ray is pumped when a massive dozer used in the oil patch arrives. Mid-way through the auction another large dozer stalls on the ramp, threatening to stop the auction in its tracks.

But these wolves are smart, very smart.

Daniel's deep resentment of his mother following his parents' divorce rapidly led to dark and menacing behavior, and she was desperate to keep the problems behind closed doors, but did her love for him seal her fate?

programme.desc: Danny goes to ask Samantha about Cape Wrath, but she is away visiting her dying father, Professor Campbell. He explains to her the Meadowlands experiment and Samantha learns who she really is.

programme.desc: An ex-policeman/school janitor (Billy Blanks) shows a new student (Kenn Scott) how to defend himself from a martial-arts bully.

programme.desc: "To his university, Professor Wolfgang McGee (Andrew Airlie - "Fifty Shades of Grey"), is a gifted academic. To his country, he is the spymaster behind the Romeo Section, a secret ring of intelligence operatives that infiltrate some of the world's deadliest criminal networks. In "The Romeo Section: Assassins", Wolfgang is tasked with revealing the truth behind an alleged terrorist attack.

programme.desc: To save their marriage, Ben and Lydia risk it all and buy a farmstead in Manitowoc, WI. Lydia is determined to transform the rotting house into a dream home and finally start a family, but Ben's photographs reveal they're not alone... Mysterious figures begin appearing in Ben's photos and Lydia unearths grotesque artifacts in their house. An odd woman called Edith (Veronica Cartwright) is found to be living in a chicken coop on their property.

programme.title: Paranormal Apparition
programme.desc: Paranormal malevolence makes Danni's dream home turn into the house from hell as she is tortured and haunted by an evil apparition.

programme.title: Old Strangers
programme.desc: Three friends reconnect in a secluded mountain town after a long quarantine. While out for a hike, the trio stumble upon something dark and terrible in the deep woods.

programme.desc: A millennia-old fox spirit is freed from her frozen prison and transforms into a dangerous seductress, consuming living hearts in search for her chance to become human.

programme.title: Atlantic Rim: Resurrection
programme.desc: Mech-bots, with even bigger and badder weapons than their predecessors, attempt to stop bio-mechanical monsters from descending on LA. But the monsters are strong too, leaving the pilots of the mech-bots scrambling to defeat the creatures.

programme.desc: A group of five college kids are forced to match wits with unwelcoming residents when they fly to a "deserted" island for a party weekend.

programme.title: Sightings

Join us as we peer into the histories of some of the most prevalent creatures in pop culture, including vampires, werewolves, zombies, and ghosts.

Emma will do the impossible to get out of that house of hell.

programme.desc: At the Metropolitan Tower, Luis and Ryan run into complications while co-listing; Ryan's fiancée, Emilia, gets in the middle of things; Fredrik lands a heavenly listing with a hellish downside.

programme.title: Planet of the Capes
programme.desc: Ryan tries the buyers' patience while trying out a new pricing strategy for a downtown duplex; Fredrik promises a buyer something his developer may not be able to deliver; Luis and a new co-lister dig a hole for themselves.

programme.title: No Sleep Till Brooklyn Sells
programme.desc: Fredrik reunites with a former client in the Williamsburg neighborhood; Luis hopes to repair his rocky relationship with a rebellious co-lister; Ryan tackles an enormous townhouse that may be too big for most New Yorkers.

programme.title: Murray Up and Wait
programme.desc: A telephone call breathes new life into a development project, but it comes with a catch Fredrik never saw coming; Ryan bends over backward for a potential buyer but receives nothing in return; Luis gets first dibs on a hot new Tribeca building.

programme.title: Tug of Warhol
programme.desc: For a new development in the NoHo neighborhood, Fredrik summons the spirit of a dead icon; after a failed shot, Luis chases down one of New York City's biggest developers; Ryan picks up a penthouse in the Flatiron District with a difficult co-lister.

programme.title: A More Modern Family
programme.desc: Ryan's relationship with his co-lister hangs by a thread, prompting him to try something new; Luis finds himself caught in the middle while trying to please a married couple; Fredrik hopes a rival will save him after the developer raises prices.

programme.title: Flagg It or Bag It
programme.desc: James and David host a backyard barbecue for their new family-oriented estate; Altman goes after a new modern home in his Bird Streets territory; Flagg tries to find a dream home in historic Hollywood Hills for actress Becca Tobin ("Glee").

programme.title: 24 Hours or Else
programme.desc: James and David experience difficulties with their Santa Monica gem, as the sellers have their own ideas about price and who the buyers should be.

programme.title: Swedish Invasion
programme.desc: James and David work with a long-time client Zach Vella to list an architectural gem, but Fredrik's arrival in Los Angeles is putting the pressure on them to get it sold.

programme.title: Medieval Time Machine
programme.desc: Altman lists a castle in Beverly Ridge; Flagg finds himself opposite Fredrik, trying to negotiate a deal while getting a fair price for his client; James and David are under pressure to get their latest Zach Vella listing sold.

programme.title: One for the 'Gram
programme.desc: Altman throws an epic launch event for a modern with a $48 million price tag and a social media twist; Tracy gets creative to find a buyer for her new WeHo modern; Los Angeles wildfires have a devastating impact on the market.

programme.title: Hollywood Royalty
programme.desc: Altman and Tracy co-list a historic Hollywood estate previously owned by Hollywood legend John Barrymore; James and David go all-in on their new East Coast traditional.

programme.title: A Swedish Soiree
programme.desc: Altman returns to his roots in the Bird Streets neighborhood to sell a modern masterpiece but has a difficult time keeping the sellers happy; Flagg adjusts to a remote work lifestyle and secretly visits Tracy's house to see an old companion.

programme.title: Counter Offer Knock Down
programme.desc: Flagg works with an old friend to sell a historic Bel Air home that is designed by a famous architect and occupied by famous owners; Tracy embraces technology in order to try and sell a property that no one is allowed to step foot in.

programme.title: Orange You Glad It's a Co-List?
programme.desc: Fredrik reels in a property in Beverly Park only to learn that the sellers want him to co-list the property with Altman; Flagg walks a fine line as he lists a tear down on a great piece of land for a seller who does not want the house torn down.

programme.title: House of Drago
programme.desc: While listing a Hamptons-esque home in Hancock Park, James and David find themselves at odds with each other; Flagg goes to the next level to protect himself and his fellow agent.

programme.title: The House That Thighmaster Built
programme.desc: Flagg packs his bags for Palm Springs to sell the home of America's favorite roommate, Suzanne Somers; Tracy balances work and family as she lists her sister's massive $30 million home in Holmby Hills.

programme.title: Two's Company, Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: After agreeing to a co-list in Bel Air, James and David struggle to get a word in edgewise during their showings; Flagg soaks in the waters of Palm Springs as he tries to sell Suzanne Somers' house.

programme.title: The Laws of Distraction
programme.desc: When Fredrik tries to get brokers to his Upper Bel Air property, he faces a huge obstacle: LA traffic; James and David create a decoy to get a sale in Bel Air; Altman negotiates against his brother.

programme.title: Have a Cookie and Relax
programme.desc: Tracy trades her broker hat for a buyer hat when she starts searching for a home in Beverly Hills and is shocked when she realizes Flagg is listing her dream house; Fredrik pushes to set a record price in Upper Bel Air.

programme.title: Gate Code Shakedown
programme.desc: Tracy goes head-to-head with Flagg on his listing in the Flats; in Beverly Hills, Altman falls in love with a midcentury masterpiece; James races to close a deal for Bernard "Harv" Harvey and his wife in the booming Valley market.

programme.title: Look Ma', We Made It
programme.desc: Tracy's Abbot Kinney property is a tough sell, but not as tough as her confrontation with Fredrik; Altman wants to make up for misbehaving as a child by giving his parents something special; Flagg's expertise is tested with a very particular buyer.

programme.title: No Moore Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Luis lands a listing with a former broker who helped him launch his career; Fredrik struggles to sell a $30 billion penthouse in Tribeca; Ryan tries to save his skin after showing too much of someone else's in a marketing campaign.

programme.title: Take a Walker
programme.desc: Fredrik confronts a broker who is circling his $30 million penthouse like a vulture; Luis will do anything for a buyer and dog; a delighted Ryan lands a listing that previously belonged to Fredrik.

programme.title: Windows to Your Sale
programme.desc: Luis faces an emotional crossroads; Fredrik tries to cash in on a NoHo loft that once was the site of the country's largest bank robbery; in Tribeca, Ryan tries to succeed where Fredrik failed.

programme.title: Real Men Wear Pink...Tutus
programme.desc: Ryan trades his suit for a more unique outfit after landing a building in Hell's Kitchen; Luis' idea of having a business partner gets more complicated when an open house challenges him to think about his future; Fredrik goes to London.

programme.title: Seaportlandia
programme.desc: Luis tries to figure out what's been confusing him lately while hoping to land a building on Park Avenue South; Ryan goes after the one listing that got away from him; Ryan shows up at Fredrik's launch party.

programme.title: It's All Greek to Me
programme.desc: Ryan and Emilia deal with complications while planning their wedding, which will take place in Greece; Ryan is preoccupied with his new building in Greenpoint, while Emilia is overwhelmed with her growing to-do list.

programme.title: Million Dollar ... Wedding?
programme.desc: Ryan's work interferes with the wedding planning, and he begins to realize if he doesn't make a change, he will lose Emilia forever.

programme.title: Poseidon Serhant
programme.desc: As Ryan scrambles to find a vacation house in Greece, the wedding plans start to fall apart; the guest list balloons, the venue experiences booking issues and Ryan's bachelor party doesn't go as planned; Luis plans a night Ryan will never forget.

programme.title: Here Comes the Bride...Zilla
programme.desc: With two days to go before Ryan and Emilia's wedding, the church calls with heart-stopping news, and when Emilia looks for Ryan to help solve the problem, he's on the opposite side of the island.

programme.title: Good as Gold
programme.desc: Fredrik and Ryan are joined by Steve Gold, a former fashion model who has become a successful agent, specializing in luxury properties; Ryan hopes to sell 50 houses in three months; a newly calm Fredrik meets a Tribeca seller who won't negotiate.

programme.title: 9021 No!
programme.desc: Fredrik and Altman return to their Beverly Park co-list with an offer, but the seller tests the bonds of their relationship; Flagg hosts an exclusive dinner party while trying to close a deal in the Beverly Hills Flats.

programme.title: Trouble in the OC
programme.desc: Even though Flagg has not found a buyer yet, Suzanne Somers' house might just sell; Tracy and her daughters check on the progress of their new house; Fredrik and Altman each snag ocean-front properties as they both want to expand into the new market.

programme.title: The Great British Cook-Off
programme.desc: Tracy's delighted to list the house of Gleb Savchenko and Elena Samodanova from "Dancing with the Stars" but it needs a facelift; the Brits get their hands dirty when hosting a dinner party at their 30-million-dollar Nightingale property.

programme.title: The One With the 7 Foot Marilyn
programme.desc: Tracy tries to dance her way to a deal on the Skyline property; Altman aims to break Brentwood records with a property that has more bells and whistles than anyone could dream of.

programme.title: The Odd Couple
programme.desc: Josh Altman and Josh Flagg enlist their spouses and head for the coast; they pull out all the stops in the hopes of securing an all-cash offer for a jeweler-client who is between a rock and a hard place.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Buy
programme.desc: Altman enlists Flagg's help in selling his parents' home in Aspen, but when news of a change in Flagg's employment leaks, all hell breaks loose; back in LA, Heather asks Bobby for advice about seeking partnership in The Altman Brothers.

programme.title: Sour Grapes
programme.desc: Flagg is blindsided when Altman decides to teach him a lesson in the middle of a high-stakes deal in wine country; Heather and Bobby are left to ponder the future of their spouses' partnership.

programme.title: On the Waterfront
programme.desc: Josh and Josh seek an elusive waterfront property for a difficult client in Newport Beach; Heather officially asks her husband and his brother, Matt, for partnership in The Altman Brothers.

programme.title: Just The Three of Us
programme.desc: Josh Altman, Josh Flagg and Tracy Tutor collaborate and compete with one another on a whole new level; Tracy takes a wild swing on a record-setting mansion; Altman gets a second chance at a listing; Flagg opens up about his divorce from Bobby.

programme.title: The First Husband's Club
programme.desc: Altman and Tracy go head-to-head on the sale of a historic property; Flagg continues to deal with both divorce and indecisive twins; Tracy's client, and her many cats, have fallen head over tails in love with a Diane Keaton property they must have.

programme.title: A Game of Cat and House
programme.desc: Tracy brings Flagg in on a deal; Altman mentors a new broker who once took a chance on him only to find out that the tables are turned.

programme.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
programme.desc: Tracy and Heather prove that two blondes are better than one when they score more than they bargained for after teaming up to sell a Beverly Hills home; Flagg discovers that Marilyn Monroe once called his new listing home.

programme.title: To Sell or Not to Sell
programme.desc: Tracy's latest listing yields an interesting new development; Josh Altman and Heather clash after having different reactions to an unexpected offer that comes knocking on their door; Josh Flagg reveals a new mystery man in his life.

programme.title: The Rocky Hazen Picture Show
programme.desc: Flagg and Altman team up to sell a deluxe apartment in the sky; Tracy and Heather join forces to sell the dream on a coveted Beverly Hills listing; neither is as easy as it seems.

programme.title: Rate Hikes and Date Nights
programme.desc: A downturn in the market is no longer conjecture but reality, which comes as a rude awakening to Altman, Flagg and Tracy; the good news is that Flagg, at least, has a pleasant new distraction named Andrew.

programme.title: Breakin' Up Is Hard to Do
programme.desc: Flagg comes face to face with his ex; Altman may run L.A., but he's still got plenty to prove in the OC; Tracy puts Juliet to work.

programme.title: Commission Omission
programme.desc: Altman and Flagg revisit a site of a previous throwdown; Tracy has fun with one of Altman's agents.

programme.title: The Kids Aren't Alright
programme.desc: Ryan and his Brooklyn team sell as many houses as possible; in order for Fredrik to land a building in SoHo, he has to prove that he's done his homework; Steve wonders if he's become a babysitter when his young clients refuse to behave.

programme.title: Frankel-y Speaking
programme.desc: Fredrik needs to find a back-up buyer, and Bethenny Frankel is at the top of his contact list; Ryan lands two townhouses but ends up competing against himself; Steve gets a listing, loses a listing and gets another listing.

programme.title: Hashtag, You're It
programme.desc: Fredrik lands a building with $400 million dollars in potential sales, but his boss thinks he may have over-promised in order to get it; Ryan juggles two sellers; Steve gets a list of demands from a broker and makes one of his own.

programme.title: Under the Influencers
programme.desc: In the hopes of selling a $20 million unit in his new mega-tower, Fredrik calls on everyone he knows, including agent Michael Lorber; Ryan goes toe-to-toe with his buyer's wingman, social media influencer The Fat Jewish.

programme.title: Ice, Ice, Ryan
programme.desc: When Ryan lands a $25 million dollar listing in Tribeca, he calls upon his most intense team member for help; in Chelsea, Steve's listing for his friend, Sam, continues to have problems, but it's nothing compared to his dating life.

programme.title: Co-List or No-List
programme.desc: When a seller demands Ryan remove his team member from a $25 million Tribeca listing, he hatches a plan that includes a secret twist; Steve lands an opportunity to sell an amazing $18 million SoHo penthouse; Fredrik and Ryan reconnect with Luis.

programme.title: It Takes a (East) Village
programme.desc: Fredrik begins questioning the effects of gentrification as he sells his $225 million development in the historic East Village; Ryan starts to doubt his sales strategy; Steve's co-lister tests his patience, nerves and even his bicycling skills.

programme.title: You Can Call Me Al...berto
programme.desc: Steve seeks to convince potential buyers that the only thing better than their Tribeca apartment is his listing right above it; a prominent developer embarrasses Ryan at a birthday party; Fredrik forges a bond with his driver, Alberto.

programme.title: Wake. Sell. Repeat.
programme.desc: Fredrik tries to set records at the open house for his Park Slope brownstone; even though Ryan's business is booming, he finds himself down in the dumps; Steve encourages a friend to sell his Soho loft and receives an offer from an unexpected source.

programme.title: Pushing the Envelopes
programme.desc: Fredrik has a strategy for his new Nolita building, designed by Lenny Kravitz and his team, and he's going to need his passport; Ryan befriends a quirky apartment owner, only to find the rug being pulled out from under him.

programme.title: The French Connection
programme.desc: In Paris, Fredrik's launch goes according to plan until another broker tries to stake his claim with the developer; Ryan contemplates a risky new career move; Luis makes an emotional revelation concerning his life in Paris.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: Altman enlists Tracy and Flagg to help him tackle a new development in Vegas; the three turn to Hollywood for inspiration for an event; the trio hopes to lure mega-wealthy buyers to a barren landscape atop the hills overlooking Sin City.

programme.title: Flagg and Loathing in Las Vegas
programme.desc: Altman, Flagg and Tracy triple-list in Vegas, which could yield high commissions; Heather confronts Altman about being left out after putting in the work to get the listing off the ground; Tracy isn't happy with Flagg's behavior.

programme.title: To the Max
programme.desc: Altman, Flagg and Tracy go full-on "Mad Max" as they throw a Hollywood movie-inspired party to launch a desert development in Vegas.

programme.title: Just When You Think You've Seen It All...
programme.desc: Tracy Tutor takes on what should be an easy-to-sell beach house in Laguna; Josh Altman adopts a problem listing in the Crest streets; Josh Flagg tries to convince a friend to sell her dream property.

programme.title: Hate to Say I Told You So
programme.desc: Altman and Tracy fight with stubborn sellers in a spiraling market when their high-end listings go nowhere; Altman debates on walking away from a client.

programme.title: Buyer's Remorse
programme.desc: Tracy attempts to rescue a pair of first-time home buyers who have buyer's remorse; Flagg visits the childhood dream house he purchased sight unseen; Altman is swimming in marble as he tries to move a mega-mansion in Pelican Crest.

programme.title: Always a danger
