programme.title: Thrown in the deep end
programme.desc: A heavy wreck and a frustrating recovery threaten to overwhelm Kevin; after a big change in his career, Sonny struggles to make a mark when a heavy load flips in the middle of the city.

programme.title: Old Wrongs
programme.desc: Stevie's daughter, Rose, is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years. Stevie hopes to rebuild their relationship, but Rose is clear that she is only here for work experience.

programme.title: Handle With Care
programme.desc: Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie. Meanwhile, Riley, Alex, Jodi and Kate take cattle along the stock route overnight.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
programme.desc: After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified when they see whom the date turns out to be. Meanwhile, Kate wants to apply for the Young Farmer of the Year award but is crushed when she learns that Jodi has entered as well since Kate has never beaten Jodi at anything.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh. Phil Rakich is instantly opposed to the idea and bad mouths the animals, which causes tension with Riley.

programme.title: Winners & Losers
programme.desc: When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife. Meanwhile, Jodi and Patrick fight over who knows Kate the best.

programme.title: Damage Control
programme.desc: During a storm, Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse, while Alex wakes up in his ute, heartbroken after seeing Stevie with another man.

programme.title: Risk
programme.desc: After being offered a two-year research job in Africa, Dave tries to pretend he isn't interested. Meanwhile, Kate wins the Young Farmers Award but risks losing the man she loves when Patrick discovers he doesn't know Kate as well as he thought.

programme.title: Twenty Questions
programme.desc: After learning of Dave's plan to move to Africa, Kate realises she still has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Fiona turns up at Killarney claiming half of the furniture and sets the tone of the conflict by sawing the dining room table in half.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: It's shearing time at Drovers Run and Jodi is happy until her conflicted feelings for Rob recently returned (now going by his real name of Matt) and Riley rise to the surface.

programme.title: All The Wrong Places
programme.desc: Kate's romantic exit has stirred up some confusing emotions for Jodi who becomes obsessed with building a new dam on Drovers, with near tragic results.

programme.title: Digging Up The Past
programme.desc: Jodi is spooked by a mysterious vision and develops an angry rash on her wrists and ankles. Meanwhile, Tayler worries when Regan doesn't return on time but has her hands full caring for an injured possum with Patrick.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Alex and Marcus come to blows over the future of Killarney, and Marcus reveals a secret that will change their lives forever. Meanwhile, Jodi is determined to help Riley make peace with his estranged father, Bill, when he visits Drovers Run.

programme.title: Reaching Out
programme.desc: Jodi questions her sanity when she is haunted by visions of her ancestor Emma McLeod and a murdered convict. Alex, angry that Marcus lied to him for so long, is doing his best to not deal with the fact that he and Marcus are brothers.

programme.title: Returned Favour
programme.desc: Jodi has her hands full with a major decision when both Riley and Matt declare their love for her. Meanwhile, Stevie may risk losing Alex again when she helps Marcus with a cattle deal.

programme.title: Of Hearts and Hunters
programme.desc: For Jodi and Matt, love is blossoming, and the world is looking remarkably sunny. Jodi suggests Matt move in permanently, and we find Matt making plans to ask Jodi to marry him, but Jodi faces a gut-wrenching decision when Matt is forced back into witness protection.

programme.title: Climb Every Mountain
programme.desc: Kate has a hard time coming to grips with her best friend's death and she decides to investigate the case of Jodi and Matt's murders herself. Meanwhile, Stevie has taken over a meeting that Jodi organised with Natural Resource Management and is determined to make her proud.

programme.title: Sisters are Doing It For Themselves
programme.desc: When Regan's sister Grace inherits part of Drovers Run from Jodi, Regan tries to reconcile with her. Stevie convinces Alex that they should keep their relationship a secret, but they quickly prove to be utterly hopeless at staying low-key.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Alex's plan to propose to Stevie goes horribly wrong when a series of accidents and disasters threaten to ruin their relationship. Meanwhile, Kate and Riley are caught in a game of theft and deception over stray cattle, as Moira finds herself on a date with Phil Rakich.

programme.title: Bloodlines
programme.desc: When sheep rustlers steal Drovers' breeding stock, Grace and Stevie take the law into their own hands. Meanwhile, Regan tries her best to convince her sister to make her stay on the ranch permanent.

programme.title: Warts and All
programme.desc: Stevie is not looking forward to being nothing more than "Mrs. Alex Ryan," and there are responsibilities that her new position brings. Bryce arrives for the engagement party, bearing an unwanted pre-nup.

programme.title: Conflicts of Interest
programme.desc: The girls fight to stop Drovers Run becoming the site of a toxic waste dump. Grace forces Regan to choose between her family and her rekindled relationship with her lover who is in charge of the site testing.

programme.title: Flesh and Stone
programme.desc: Grace kidnaps a government official to prevent the toxic dump from going ahead. Regan is also fighting to save Drovers Run, though her relationships with Grace and Lyle may reach a crisis point in the process.

programme.title: All's Fair In Love and War
programme.desc: Rose arrives at Drovers Run accompanied by Stevie's mother, Helen. Rose hoped to act as a peacemaker between the two, but instead, years of bitterness pour out.

programme.title: Ever After
programme.desc: On Alex and Stevie's long-awaited wedding day, things will run smoothly if the groom is able to get out of jail in time to make it to the altar. Meanwhile, Alex's sister Ashleigh attempts to ruin the wedding and take over Killarney.

programme.title: Grace Under Fire
programme.desc: While clashing with a rich new neighbour, Heath Barrett, Grace becomes convinced she's cursed Drovers Run when a series of bizarre plagues strike the farm. Meanwhile, while Alex is away on his honeymoon with Stevie, Ashleigh runs amok when she undermines Marcus' authority on Killarney.

programme.title: Gift Horse
programme.desc: ile desperately trying to resist Heath's charms, Grace questions her future on Drovers Run when she learns that her best friend has died.

programme.title: Hot Water
programme.desc: Grace may be making a deal with the devil when she accepts a secret loan from Ashleigh after the bank refuses credit to Drovers Run. Meanwhile, after Grace and Kate are taken hostage by a bankrupt farmer, Moira has a premonition that someone will get shot by the gunman.

programme.title: Leaving the Nest
programme.desc: Stevie returns from her honeymoon and plans to spend the summer with Rose before she starts university, but Rose has plans of her own which involve taking a year off to travel overseas. Meanwhile, Grace is forced to take desperate measures to repay Ashleigh, and Riley trains a new horse.

programme.title: Spark From Heaven
programme.desc: Rose returns from the hospital in a wheelchair and is involved in a freak car crash that may not have been an accident. Moira convinces the girls to do a naked rain dance, with unexpected results, and sceptic Phil gains a new respect for Moira's psychic gifts.

programme.title: The Courage Within
programme.desc: While the girls are investigating a mysterious explosion at the fuel dump, wheelchair-bound Rose is trapped at the homestead during a brazen robbery attempt. Meanwhile, Marcus and Heath clash over Grace's controversial drought-proofing plan, and Ashleigh blackmails Grace into lying to the police.

programme.title: Divided We Stand
programme.desc: Stevie's loyalty to Drovers Run is tested when she moves into Killarney. Meanwhile, Grace is trying to move ahead with her drought-proofing plan. Kate falls for Mitch, an ex-army mate of Riley's, who arrives with a dark secret and Riley makes a dangerous enemy when he rejects Ashleigh's advances.

programme.title: On The Prowl
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run team up with the men from Killarney to hunt the dangerous beast that is killing Drovers stock. Meanwhile, Riley discovers Mitch is trading stolen army weapons, and while Riley's unwilling to turn him into the police, Ashleigh has no such qualms.

programme.title: Fanning the Flames
programme.desc: Blinded by love, Kate decides to go on the run with her outlaw boyfriend Mitch. Meanwhile, Drovers Run and other local farms are the victims of a professional arsonist.

programme.title: My Enemy My Friend
programme.desc: Grace faces an uphill battle to save Ashleigh's life when they are left stranded in the bush after being involved in a serious car accident on an isolated road. Meanwhile, an expensive stud bull is poisoned on Drovers Run, and the girls are convinced someone is trying to bankrupt them.

programme.title: Knight In Shining Armour
programme.desc: During preparations for a Medieval Fair organised for drought relief, Grace is shocked when Heath proposes marriage. With Ashleigh having called in her loan and Drovers under threat, the girls decide to hold an auction to raise the necessary cash, selling off everything they can spare.

programme.title: The Short Cut
programme.desc: Grace takes drastic action to capture a cattle thief, and the girls uncover Ashleigh's secret plan to bankrupt Drovers Run. The girls team up to try and stop her before it's too late to save the ranch.

programme.title: Seeing Is Believing
programme.desc: It's Halloween and odd things occur on Drovers Run as the horror stories the girls tell over dinner start to come true. Kate is convinced she has killed Ashleigh in a hit-and-run accident, but can't find the body anywhere.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: The arrival of a mysterious stranger forces Grace to reconsider her future with Heath. He wants to move them to Queensland to take over a horse stud and set up camp drafting school.

programme.title: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: Marcus suspects Heath is cheating on Grace, but jealousy might be clouding his judgement. Grace starts to question Heath's love for her until Heath surprises her with an amazing gift.

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve, and Alex makes a surprise return from Argentina to visit Stevie. Meanwhile, Grace finds proof of Heath's infidelity, and Kate and Riley finally admit their attraction to each other when they kiss under the mistletoe.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: The car accident has thrown everyone off balance. Kate is obsessed with proving Riley survived, Grace tries to find the mystery person who rescued her, and Patrick mistakenly feels he's invincible.

programme.title: The Pitfalls of Love
programme.desc: Grace and Marcus are trapped at the bottom of an abandoned mine shaft, and help needs to arrive before Grace develops severe hypothermia. Kate helps Father Dan by caring for a cantankerous elderly woman who has some useful advice for grieving Kate

programme.title: Wild Ride
programme.desc: Stevie's wild-at-heart former rodeo mate, Sharon, visits Drovers Run and turns everyone's lives upside down. Meanwhile, Marcus sacrifices his chances in a major horse endurance race to save Ingrid from an abusive rider.

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Kate is finishing her pipe project when she comes across a young runaway, Jamie, broken down on the stock route. She tries to talk to him, but he runs, stealing her car. Eventually, Kate catches Jamie.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: There seems to be an intruder haunting Drovers and Moira is spooked by strange noises in the night. Eventually, they discover the culprit: a grubby, nine-year-old girl called Lily. Moira is suspicious, and when her dad, Frank, picks her up, he is clearly hiding something.

programme.title: Close Enough to Touch
programme.desc: Alex returns from Argentina and his reunion with Stevie begins blissfully. Moira has helped her set up a romantic picnic spot for their first supper together since the honeymoon.

programme.title: Bringing Up Wombat
programme.desc: Stevie decides to leave Drovers Run and move to Killarney to secure her son's future, but in the wake of the tragedy, she makes a series of rash management decisions that do just the opposite.

programme.title: Three Sisters
programme.desc: Jaz returns to Drovers Run and clashes with Grace, leaving Regan stuck playing the role of peacemaker. Stevie, however, is glad to see Jaz and feels their old tensions are behind them. Jaz volunteers to help out around the farm but discovers she's picked up the wrong bag at the bus stop.

programme.title: Dammed
programme.desc: The girls of Drovers Run band together with the local community to stop a massive dam being built upstream. When Olympic-hopeful Jaz is made the face of the campaign, she finds herself blackmailed by pro-dam farmer Terri Barker, who threatens to reveal an explosive secret from her past.

programme.title: Mother Love
programme.desc: Tayler and Patrick's happy domesticity is disrupted when Tayler's mother, Jane, returns. Jane wants to set the record straight with her daughter about why she left, but Tayler is wary. Meanwhile, baby Xander has not smiled yet, and it's worrying Stevie immensely.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big Trouble
programme.desc: Grace, Jaz, Marcus, and Frank head off to the city to confront the Minister responsible for a dam proposal that will take away their water. Meanwhile, Phil gives Moira a personal and surprising gift.

programme.title: Love and Let Die
programme.desc: Jaz is taken aback when Lily reveals her dad, Frank, is talking about proposing to her. Jaz needs to decide how to deal with the situation. Frank's hopes for a stable family life take a pounding when he learns that his ex-wife has a new job in Queensland and intends to take Lily with her.

programme.title: A Dog's Life
programme.desc: Marcus has been looking for a new overseer for weeks, but given his constant clashing with Ben, neither of them can accept that Ben is right for the job. The district Yard Dog trials are fast approaching when Ben is befriended by a border collie.

programme.title: My Prince Will Come
programme.desc: After finding her horse from Europe grazing in the paddock, Jaz is surprised to discover she has been personally delivered by Mischa. The others are stunned to discover Mischa is a wealthy prince and Jaz's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Snogging Frogs
programme.desc: Concerned that Jaz is getting caught up in Mischa's scheme to clear her name, Grace threatens to report him to the officials if he puts Jaz at risk by going through with his plan. Moira debates telling Phil she is pregnant, and his reaction is far from what she expected.

programme.title: The Merry Widow
programme.desc: Rumours run amok after the ball, as the town believes Steve is dating Marcus. Repercussions occur when one man, Ted Franklin, causes problems for Drovers Run and Tayler takes it upon herself to dig up gossip on him to bargain with.

programme.title: Show Pony
programme.desc: Following a costly accident, Ben helps Jaz try to determine what is spooking her horse, Annie, as she hopes to use her for work on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Grace discovers that some of the new Drovers cattle have been stolen, and Tayler poses as Ingrid's assistant after a mistake.

programme.title: Every Move You Make
programme.desc: Ingrid's husband Paul is investigating the cattle theft, and Ingrid is scared of what he might do if he finds out about her relationship with Marcus. Meanwhile, Phil is trying to make Moira feel better and has planned a special evening.

programme.title: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: Out of the hospital after being shot, Ingrid's husband Paul is determined to get his wife and he will not let anyone stand in his way. Ingrid is more concerned than ever for her own safety, as well as that of her friends who did their best to help her.

programme.title: The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: Rehearsals are in full swing as Moira prepares to play the leading girl in Phil's musical. During the preparations, she finds out that Phil's son is getting married, but Phil isn't planning to attend the wedding, and she decides to interfere.

programme.title: Into the Valley of the Shadow
programme.desc: Hit hard by the drought and facing a growing debt, the very future of Drovers Run is at stake. The girls need help to shear all their sheep in one day to get them to a sale in time if they hope to save the ranch.

programme.title: The Long Paddock
programme.desc: With the land of Drovers Run on the line, Stevie musters all her determination to do the impossible. Meanwhile, Grace resolves her feeling for Marcus and faces a difficult decision, while Patrick and Tayler make their plans.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: Half-sisters Tess and Claire are reunited when they take over the family ranch, Drovers Run, after their father's death.

programme.title: Ducks on the Pond
programme.desc: It's shearing time and one of the men arrives with a reputation as a killer. Tess witnesses some strange events and uncovers a secret.

programme.title: Don't Mess with the Girls
programme.desc: Jealousy abounds as Claire competes in the rodeo and two men compete for Tess's affection; Becky's reputation gets her in trouble.

programme.title: Who's the Boss?
programme.desc: Claire buys a pen of undernourished sheep from the stock sales, leaving Tess to question her judgment.

programme.title: Taking the Reins
programme.desc: Tess's confidence is shaken after she falls from her horse, forcing her to wonder whether she truly belongs at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: Tess finds out that Jack loved Claire; Meg and Claire discover more about Becky's life when she returns to the truck stop.

programme.title: Pride and Joy
programme.desc: Claire must pay off a debt to Harry Ryan, who has his eye on Drovers Run. Tapped out of cash, she has no choice but to offer him her father's old mahogany desk, which is steeped in sentimental value for her and Tess.

programme.title: Stir Crazy
programme.desc: When Claire's new mare runs off with a wild stallion, Alex and Nick offer their help. Tess and Nick search for the horses on motorbikes while Alex and Claire take to the skies in a helicopter.

programme.title: Into The Woods
programme.desc: Just when Tess thinks she's beginning to get the hang of ranch life, the hunt for a dangerous wild boar that is threatening the livestock disrupts life and throws her skills into question.

programme.title: Haunted
programme.desc: Emotional and traumatic events of the past and present return to haunt the lives of the women of Drovers Run. The pain of dealing with loss forces each of them to find a way to deal with these life-altering events.

programme.title: Who's a Big Girl Now?
programme.desc: The youngest member of the Drovers Run family is ready to celebrate her 18th birthday in style, but no one seems very interested in helping her mark such a special occasion.

programme.title: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light when an innocent question by Tess re-opens a very ugly wound.

programme.title: True Love and Consequences
programme.desc: When Bill Tilson decides to sell up and move to the city, Claire sees the precariousness of her own situation and it prompts her to work harder than ever to keep Drovers Run.

programme.title: Dirty Pool
programme.desc: Theft is on everyone's mind since there are cattle duffers working in the district and a flock of Claire's sheep has gone missing.

programme.title: If the Boot Fits...
programme.desc: When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run. In spite of a few doubts, Claire gives her a new pair of boots to honour the occasion, and it turns out that Tess will truly have to earn them.

programme.title: Playing to Win
programme.desc: The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality, and a sudden drive to defy whatever fate may have in store by pursuing a rapid expansion of his property.

programme.title: Girls Night Out
programme.desc: After reaping good profits at the sheep sales, the girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.

programme.title: More Than One Way...
programme.desc: Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex. Her dream of developing a quarter horse breeding program at Drovers Run looks as if it may be close to coming true and she's using it as an excuse to push Tess away.

programme.title: Cartas Marcadas
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes rancheros reciben una herencia de la madrina de ambos y solo les será entregada si se casan entre sí.

programme.title: El sultán descalzo
programme.desc: Un vagabundo vive de hacer favores en una vecindad y finge ser profesor para darle clases de baile a una bella joven.

programme.title: Dos locos en escena
programme.desc: El encargado de un teatro es asesinado para quitarle la nómina y su cadáver es escondido en un camerino.

programme.title: Ni solteros ni casados
programme.desc: Dos recién casados, deseosos de empezar su luna de miel, deben esperar su celebración a causa de varios imprevistos.

programme.title: Por la puerta falsa
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene en su poder la hipoteca de la hacienda de sus antiguos patrones y quiere casarse con la hija de ellos por la fuerza.

programme.title: Una mujer que no miente
programme.desc: Una joven recibe la "medalla de la imaginación" por mentirosa al concluir su curso en un colegio para señoritas.

programme.title: El camino de los espantos
programme.desc: Una tormenta impide que un grupo de personas prosiga su viaje por tren a la capital y continúan por un camino hechizado.

programme.title: Si Adelita se fuera con otro
programme.desc: Un rico ranchero se enamora de una soldadera, pero la familia de la chica no lo quiere por ser seguidor de Pancho Villa.

programme.title: La mujer sin alma
programme.desc: Una joven humilde coquetea con varios hombres de clase alta y se compromete con uno, pero recibe costosos regalos de otro.

programme.title: Los Tres Mosqueteros y Medio
programme.desc: Tin Tan se convierte en medio mosquetero, en esta película de capa y espada basada en la obra de Alejandro Dumas.

programme.title: Hipólito el de Santa
programme.desc: Hipólito es un pianista ciego que ofrece refugio a una joven desvalida llamada Santa. Él se enamora de la chica y hace todo lo posible para que no se dé cuenta de su ceguera al conocer su casa a la perfección, pero un error terminará con la ilusión.

programme.title: ¡Ay pena, penita, pena!
programme.desc: En España, dos hermanos compran a una gitana un billete de lotería que resulta ganador y vuelven con ella a México.

programme.title: Muchachas que trabajan
programme.desc: Cuatro trabajadoras de una tienda enfrentan varias dificultades como un asesinato, chantajes y robos.

programme.title: No Basta Ser Charro
programme.desc: Un ranchero se hace pasar por el famoso cantante Jorge Negrete para conquistar a la mujer de quien está enamorado.

programme.title: El rey del barrio
programme.desc: Un hombre pobre se convierte en un Robin Hood moderno, robando a los ricos para darles a los pobres.

programme.title: Secretaria Particular
programme.desc: Una joven recibe una herencia del padre que nunca conoció y luego finge ser la secretaria de un amigo.

programme.title: Médico de guardia
programme.desc: El director de un hospital engaña a una pareja pobre para robarles a su hijo recién nacido y venderlo a una pareja rica.

programme.title: Dos locos en escena
programme.desc: El encargado de un teatro es asesinado para quitarle la nómina y su cadáver es escondido en un camerino.

programme.title: El criado malcriado
programme.desc: Tras dirigir el asalto a un banco, un hombre es atropellado y llevado a casa de su tía quién lo emplea como chofer.

programme.title: Cómo atrapar a un don Juan
programme.desc: Un estafador organiza la evacuación de capitales a Ginebra para quedarse con el dinero ganado en especulaciones.

programme.title: ¡Qué Familia Tan Cotorra!
programme.desc: Un taxista desempleado y su esposa embarazada deben mantener a una familia formada por abuelos, hermanos y tíos.

programme.title: Viva el amor
programme.desc: Una actriz planea fugarse con un hombre casado que quiere divorciarse de su esposa y se mete en una serie de problemas.

programme.title: Dos criados malcriados
programme.desc: Un padre desea casar a una de sus dos bellas hijas con un conde, para ello alquila una mansión y contrata a dos criados.

programme.title: No Basta Ser Charro
programme.desc: Un ranchero se hace pasar por el famoso cantante Jorge Negrete para conquistar a la mujer de quien está enamorado.

programme.title: Los Cuatro Juanes
programme.desc: Juan Sin Miedo (Javier Solis), Juan Colorado (Antonio Aguilar), Juan Pistolas (Luis Aguilar) y Juan Charrasqueado unen sus destinos durante la Revolución Mexicana.

programme.title: Cartas a Eufemia
programme.desc: Un joven va a la capital a ayudar al padre de su novia que está preso y ella espera con ilusión las cartas de su amado.

programme.title: En peligro de muerte
programme.desc: Viruta y Capulina buscan oro en el desierto, pero son capturados por unos indios de quienes se hacen amigos.

programme.title: Ley fuga
programme.desc: Un policía corrupto aplica la ley fuga durante su labor para cobrar las recompensas ofrecidas por el sistema.

programme.title: Dos tipos de cuidado
programme.desc: Dos grandes amigos son muy mujeriegos, pero uno ama a la hermana del otro, pero por enredos de faldas la pierde.

programme.title: La diosa arrodillada
programme.desc: La esposa de un empresario posa desnuda a sus espaldas, pero cuando su esposo se entera sobrevienen los problemas.

programme.title: Paco el elegante
programme.desc: El jefe de un grupo de traficantes de mujeres y narcóticos asesina por error a un periodista y su novia venga su muerte.

programme.title: Juan Pistolas
programme.desc: La última película de Javier Solís. Juan Pistolas ofrece su vida y dinero para comprar armas y ayudar a la Revolución.

programme.title: Dos gallos de pelea
programme.desc: Un hombre involucrado en la rivalidad entre dos familias es culpado de un asesinato y es obligado a esconderse.

programme.title: Juan Colorado
programme.desc: El alma de un hombre está dividida entre el amor y la venganza.

programme.title: En tiempos de la Inquisición
programme.desc: Un fraile absuelve a una joven cristiana enamorada de un musulmán, este será ejecutado por órdenes del corregidor.

programme.title: Flor de durazno
programme.desc: Un joven va a trabajar a Estados Unidos y su novia cree que la ha abandonado; poco después, un hombre rico la seduce.

programme.title: Pobres pero sinvergüenzas
programme.desc: Dos vagabundos encuentran a una niña y no tienen mejor idea que criarla como si fueran sus padres, pero cuando crece, deciden dejarla con una mujer para que la adopte.

programme.title: Ataque de pánico; El arpa
programme.desc: Dos modelos se pelean porque una de ellas ganó el "casting", después de hacerle una jugada sucia a la otra y provocar su traslado al hospital. Demanda al arrendatario por vivir con una loca.

programme.title: Problema de falda; Adicto al play
programme.desc: Pide empleo en un restaurante donde solo trabajan chicas, considera que fomentan la discriminación. Susana le exige que Mario vaya a terapia para que supere su adicción a los videojuegos.

programme.title: Bote de la muerte; El gato montés
programme.desc: La esposa de Fabio muere durante un paseo en el bote de Edi, ella dejó un seguro de vida a nombre del anfitrión. Tiene que abortar por el ataque de un felino y decide demandar a su condominio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.

programme.title: Hija perdida; No es un polvo, es un diamante
programme.desc: Seguramente se introduce en la casa de su familia verdadera y ahora la reclama como suya. Se hizo un anillo de compromiso con las cenizas de su padre, su madre se niega a que su esposo esté ahí.

programme.title: Hot vegan; Gallo que canta
programme.desc: Stephany se graba desnuda para su canal de recetas veganas, pero su esposo distribuye el material en una web porno. Ramón usa su gallo como apoyo sexual, su vecino no soporta el canto del ave.

programme.title: Terrible despertar; Desgarrada de huevos
programme.desc: Alexander está hundido en la depresión, su amiga y terapeuta le decide aplicarle un tratamiento de choque y él piensa que morirá. Valentín demanda a Débora por arrancarle un testículo.

programme.title: Mi mujer me embarazó; La chef
programme.desc: Brendan quiere abortar, pues el feto afecta su proceso de transformación, pero su pareja no está de acuerdo. Por enfermedad, convierte a su hija en su cuidadora, una responsabilidad de adultos.

programme.title: El amante bandido; Muñeca menor de edad
programme.desc: Adrián demanda al amante de su esposa por haber destruido deliberadamente su matrimonio. Juan está obsesionado con una muñeca inflable con apariencia de niña, su esposa está asustada.

programme.title: Gordito lento; Menuda broma
programme.desc: La obesidad ayuda a José a luchar contra la eyaculación precoz, pero afecta su salud. Una madre pierde la custodia de sus hijos, porque su esposo hace peligrosos videos de bromas con ellos.

programme.title: El narcicista; Un instruso no deseado
programme.desc: El esposo de Jenny se ha convertido en un narcisista que solo aprecia su propia belleza. Por proteger la calidad de sus plantas de marihuana, elimina una gran cantidad de abejas del vecino.

programme.title: Contagiando hepatitis; Fianza sin retorno
programme.desc: Contagia de hepatitis A a su yerno y a un amigo, pero no a los nietos. Alina pierde su bote tras ponerlo como colateral de la fianza del hermano de su nuera Fary, y ahora quiere que se lo pague.

programme.title: Slime; La canción de la desgracia
programme.desc: Un bebé muere por un "slime" que hicieron sus hermanos mientras estaban con su madrastra. Pide una canción biográfica para su matrimonio, el resultado es tan desastroso que se cancela la boda.

programme.title: La línea azul; Alegre despertar
programme.desc: Dos hermanos no se soportan y sus padres no saben cómo resolverlo. Sufre de una rara enfermedad, toma bebidas energéticas para no quedarse dormido, ahora no puede conciliar el sueño.

programme.title: Colmillo de león; Renta suicida
programme.desc: Efraín demanda a su padre por introducir dos colmillos de león en su maleta para pasarlos por la aduana. La mujer de Pedro se suicida en casa de Lourdes, él cree que ella la incitó.

programme.title: Sospecha infundada; Gambling
programme.desc: Katiuska exige que su madrastra pague sus deudas médicas, por su culpa ella perdió su embarazo. María Alejandra acusa a su esposo de usarla como moneda de cambio en una deuda, la violaron.

programme.title: Menor mentirosa; Adictos al dolor
programme.desc: Luis responsabiliza a Ricardo del suicidio de su hija, lo acusa de prostituirla en Las Vegas. Marta va a prisión por drogas y sus hijos se quedan con su hermana, quien no le permite verlos.

programme.title: Viaje en deportación; A la luz pública
programme.desc: A Camila la van a deportar por culpa de su exjefe Raúl, quien la envió en busca de mercancía y de un amigo ilegal. Mariana demanda a una periodista por informar que había defraudado al gobierno.

programme.title: Afeitador pro; Más que tango
programme.desc: Cristian le exige a su madre el dinero que su padre dejó para sus estudios, pero ese fondo ya no existe. En otro caso, Armando y su profesora bailan tango con mucha pasión y Jenny se molesta.

programme.title: Control urbano; Hombre niña
programme.desc: Un dúo de músicos urbanos denuncia que su productor los controla con un reloj que no pueden quitarse. Adrián cumple su deseo de vestirse y actuar como niña, su esposa le pide el divorcio.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la culpa?; La ecografía del diablo
programme.desc: Enyer le pide a su tío que cumpla el contrato que firmaron, él se niega porque no cuidó de su hijo. Angélica quiere abortar, cree que tiene al diablo en la barriga, su esposo busca internarla.

programme.title: Pegado a su ex; Desaparecida por la herencia
programme.desc: Victoria exige que la mujer de su exesposo le pague lo que le prestó, ella alega que vive en su casa gratis. Gustavo pide el divorcio, su mujer lo acusa de matar a la hija por la herencia.

programme.title: Enamorado de la nieta; Yo te salvé la vida
programme.desc: Su esposo la llama por el nombre de su abuela, ella descubre que es su abuelo. La esposa lo espera en tierra y para que no lo atrapen con su amante, la lanza de la avioneta en paracaídas.

programme.title: Venganza fálica; Los duques de Sealand
programme.desc: Compra la empresa donde sufrió acoso y pone a su exjefe a trabajar como pene gigante. Los duques de Sealand, el país más pequeño del mundo, se enfrentan por títulos nobiliarios y propiedades.

programme.title: Asesino en redes; El patrimonio de mi hijo
programme.desc: Sofía descubre que su marido cumplió prisión por asesinar y descuartizar a su exesposa. En otro caso, Catalina y Walid tienen una joyería, ella decide esconder unos diamantes.

programme.title: El robo de la uva; Pick
programme.desc: Sebastián y José son hermanos que pelean por una uva que produce un excelente vino. Una pareja enfrenta un serio problema: la abuela padece una enfermedad que desinhibe los deseos sexuales.

programme.title: Enano meme; El primer amor

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: Join Phil in the place he calls the "City of Sweets" as he indulges in some of the finest hot chocolate, football-sized croissants and vanilla bombes and searches for the best roast chicken and vegetable-centric dishes in the City of Lights.

programme.title: POLENTA
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a large pot of bubbling polenta, a dish that she grew up with and loved. From that polenta, she'll bake Crostini with Mixed Mushrooms and Cheese which is a perfect starter to any meal. Her granddaughter, Julia, joins her in the kitchen to help assemble and of course, taste! She'll then prepare a Hearty Polenta Dish with Bacon and Broccoli, a perfect combination. Finally, she'll make Sweet Skillet Sausage with Mixed Grapes.

programme.title: Ryan Simpson
programme.desc: Chef Ryan Simpson's series of culinary challenges includes how to make the perfect sauce vierge.

programme.title: Celebratory Food Traditions
programme.desc: Rutledge Wood and Damaris Philips find themselves in the unofficial Cajun capital of the south -- the French Louisiana region of Acadiana in Lafayette, Louisiana. Their first stop is Cafe Vermilionville for their New Orleans-inspired Crawfish 'Beignets' and Turtle Soup. Next, it's off to roadside stop Best Stop Boudin for their Boudin Blanc, Boudin Balls and fan-favorite Cracklins.

programme.title: Smoky Mountain Majesty
programme.desc: Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood continue their tour in Knoxville, Tennessee -- a city that insists on using only the freshest regional ingredients for its spectacular Southern cuisine. Their first stop is at a down-home spot called the Lunch House where the meat 'n three plate with a superstar meatloaf is as good as grandma's. Next, it's a drive into the mountains of rustic Appalachia for some homemade ham-jam biscuits, spicy pickles and delectable pork belly with a tea-poached egg on top.

programme.title: Chicken: Winged Victory
programme.desc: Julia picks a plump and perfect chicken for her dinner table. A first course of Fresh Santa Barbara Shrimp is prepared by Wolfgang Puck and Richard Graff suggests wines.

programme.title: episode 4
programme.desc: Grilled scallions with mushroom, anchovy and a poached or hard boiled egg. Poached monkfish or mackerel with frothy green hollandaise sauce. Peas and new potatoes. Apricot tart with almond praline cream.

programme.title: episode 2
programme.desc: Celeriac fritters. Casserole roast pheasant with Indian spices and Jerusalem artichokes. Yellow rice. Sicilian casatta with pistachios, candied peel, roses and lemon.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Lazy Salmon and Sides
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Lazy Salmon and Sides! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lifford/Maine & New Hampshire
programme.desc: In this episode, we first travel to Donegal to meet Ann to find out who is living away from home. Later Ann rustles up the dishes that remind James and Monica of home in Donegal, Snowballs and an Apple Pie. Catherine then travels to the US in hope to replicate Ann's dishes and bring a taste like home over to James and Monica.

programme.title: The BBQ Triangle
programme.desc: Kansas City, Kansas, and Houston, Texas, and North Carolina: Which style of barbecue reigns supreme - Kansas City, Houston, or North Carolina? Anthony Bourdain journeys to all three, judging the secrets behind sauces, wood pits, and slow smokers.

programme.title: Mad Tony: The Food Warrior
programme.desc: Sydney, Australia: Bourdain embarks on a pilgrimage through Australia to indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs, Tetsuya Wakuda. Days, miles and many Australian meals later, Anthony finds himself unable to describe Tetsuya's delicious and well-earned meal.

programme.title: Brooke Burke
programme.desc: Brooke gets candid about her career in entertainment, including her favorite gig and her firing from Dancing with the Stars.

programme.title: La Riviera Revisit
programme.desc: Today the restaurant's return to form has led to plans for expansion. Loic is still there, and now he's been promoted to Executive Chef he will oversee any new ventures.

programme.title: Celebratory Food
programme.desc: Tom prepares decadent, showstopping dishes for special occasions, including an elegant asparagus served with his ultimate salad dressing, a slow-roast duck, deep-fried oysters, spiced monkfish, and a refreshing gin and tonic granita.

programme.title: Food for Friends
programme.desc: Cooking for friends should not be time-consuming and should be a big hit with your friends. So, how do you accomplish this? Think: Sunday roast and a slow cooker, or mussels in ale. What about a hearty chorizo and chickpea stew?

programme.title: Leo
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Leo! She starts with a dish of quail and a sauce of honey, butter and Calvados for a fire-sign flambe! The next dish is one that's fit for a king (or queen): Siobhan's take on Clams Casino, covered in bacon and breadcrumbs! Next, a gigantic cast iron-seared, dry-aged rib steak, cooked to perfection and butter-basted, served alongside roast garlic and chili-spiked broccolini. Finally, a decadent orange-chocolate tart, with a gingersnap-hazelnut crust.

programme.title: Ghormeh Sabzi with the Mehditach Family
programme.desc: Elizabeth and Raya are in the kitchen for a showdown over the Middle Eastern staple ghormeh sabzi. This savory stew is gaining popularity in the US, but this family has been perfecting it for over fifty years. Who makes it better, mother or daughter?

programme.title: Girls' Festival
programme.desc: In honor of the Girls' Festival, Kaga invites a challenger from the ancient city of Kamakura, Motohito Kondo, who was trained in Kyoto and is an expert in both tea and sake.

programme.title: Fatty Tuna
programme.desc: Tasaki is a world champion sommelier who has always dreamed of becoming a famed chef. Chairman Kaga decides to grant him his wish.

programme.title: Ladyfingers Genoise with Flo Braker
programme.desc: Flo Braker, author of two cookbooks, prepares petits fours, ladyfingers, madeleines and miniature Florentine squares.

programme.title: Chef Eric's Culinary Classroom
programme.desc: Join world-renowned Chef Eric Crowley for his first Masterclass video series inspiring you to feel confident in the kitchen with several spectacular dishes that are easy to create.

programme.title: Castello di San Martino Alfieri (Piedmont, Italy)
programme.desc: The glorious Baroque castle, belonging to the sisters San Martino di Germano, lies in the picturesque Piedmont hillside, between Asti and Alba.

programme.title: Artstetten Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale has been invited to Artstetten Castle by the ancestors of the Habsburg Royal Family in Austria.

programme.title: Italian Sundays
programme.desc: Join us for Sunday dinners with the family on Xumo Free Food TV, serving up delicious Italian recipes from your favorite chefs.

programme.title: Episode 25
programme.desc: Molly proves "that's the way to do it" when she makes a replica Punch and Judy cake.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: In Chelmsford, one of Eloise's returning customers has ordered a cake that is edible for both humans and dogs, but can Eloise avoid this tricky task turning into a dog's dinner?

programme.title: Rule 5: Watch What You Feed Your Kids
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: Rule 1: There Is Only One Rules
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: PERFECT ROASTED CHICKEN
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: BRAISING
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: Fermentation, Preservation and Exploration
programme.desc: The human quest to plan for times of scarcity during times of plenty by preserving food.

programme.title: Sundae Sermon Music Festival
programme.desc: Art and cocktails mix together at Paint N' Pour, an inspiring place where anyone can find their inner artist, the Sundae Sermon Music Festival attracts people from far and wide, and Harlem Cycle aims to help people stay healthy and happy.

programme.title: Paris Blues in Harlem
programme.desc: Raphael Benavides Baccus speaks with us about his two legendary establishments: The Cecil Steakhouse and Minton's Playhouse, Film Producer Nadhege Ptah sheds light on the film "Paris Blues in Harlem," and we learn how Harlem fights cancer.

programme.title: episode 6
programme.desc: Pan-fried hake with herb relish. Casserole of roast chicken with Indian spices. Pilaff rice with parsley. Curly kale. Kiwi fruit granita with passion fruit and orange sauce. Lacy nut biscuits.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: This week Ireland's most experienced cookery teacher Rory O'Connell starts his delicious menu with smoked mackerel tonnato with heritage tomatoes,basil, and a hen's egg. He then puts his own twist on a traditional main of roast leg of spring lamb with mint hollandaise, and a tangle of spring vegetables. To finish, rory prepares roasted hazelnut panna cotta with chocolate and caramel sauce.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Makeup Meal
programme.desc: Anyone can say sorry, but a meal says it better. Nadia G whips zucchini blossoms, curried chicken pot pie, and apple-maple crumble with candied bacon-apology, served.

programme.title: Popular
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Budae Jjigae
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Budae Jjigae! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Fethard-on-Sea/Newfoundland
programme.desc: On Tastes Like Home Catherine Fulvio travels to Newfoundland and goes Whale Watching in search for Humpbacks and Minke Whales, she visits Quidi Vidi village and Cape Spear Lighthouse and "The Rooms Museum" which houses an exhibit showing when and where the Irish arrived and settled in Newfoundland.

programme.title: Robin Roberts and Joseph Sikora
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle makes a slow-cooked Southern meal for her good friend and morning show anchor Robin Roberts. She's treated to Patti's mouth-watering Corn Beef served with Fierce Fried Cabbage and rice with homemade gravy. Later, actor Joseph Sikora from the hit show Power gets his appetite satisfied with a tender T-bone steak and sauteed Brussels sprouts with turkey bacon served alongside garlic Yukon gold mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Carrie Ann Inaba and Cedric the Entertainer
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites comedian Cedric the Entertainer over for a hearty meal. They laugh out loud in the kitchen as Patti cooks up juicy and tender lamb chops served with candied sweet potatoes and fresh sauteed spinach. Then, Dancing with the Stars judge Carrie Ann Inaba stops by for a sweet treat, and Patti makes it a family affair when she prepares Aunt Hattie Mae's Raspberry Pie -- a simple and delicious dessert that's a perfect 10.

programme.title: Spice + Sweet
programme.desc: On this sweet episode of Spice Secrets, chef/hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud cook three dishes that all represent the sweeter side of cooking with spice, though not in the way you'd expect! You'll never see donuts the same way again after trying Chocolate-Glazed Coriander Donuts... with a Cilantro-Lime filling! Next, Asian Spring Rolls and Plum Sauce meet both Spanish Smoky and Hungarian Sweet Paprikas! Finally, a truly unique dish that can only be described as Duck Meets Vanilla.

programme.title: Fennel Family
programme.desc: Cook along with Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim as they delve into all things anise! First, they get things rolling with an apple, fennel, and radish salad with a star anise spiked vinaigrette! Next up, Baked Mac and Cheese gets a duo of fennel: the vegetable and the seed! Finally, a pork tenderloin with a simple mixed berry sauce. Where's the fennel you ask? They rub the pork with fennel-cousin cumin for some smoky aroma and flavour! Remember... a pinch of spice makes a world of difference!

programme.title: Malaysia
programme.desc: Gordon is in Malaysia where he quickly learns it's the women and not the chefs that rule the kitchens.

programme.title: Forest
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik put their heads together to design a three-course menu, highlighting the gifts of the forest! Mushrooms, venison, cranberries, and - of course - black forest cake!

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Angelique and Tina meet in the romantic studio kitchen to win the heart of vineyard worker David. Who will leave as the best of friends?

programme.title: Sushi - Crudo - Ceviche
programme.desc: Fish has been an important source of food since the beginning of mankind. This time, it's sushi, crudo, and ceviche-and how different cultures took the concept of eating fresh, raw fish, and turned it into a global food trend.

programme.title: Senegal
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Discover Bay, a Caribbean restaurant from Huddersfield, and Santa Maria Del Sur, an Argentinian restaurant from London, battle to be chosen as Gordon's best restaurant from North and South America.

programme.title: The Impact
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: To Make A Buche
programme.desc: For Julia Child, it's a party when this elaborately silly, log-shaped jelly roll appears. It's Christmas, Washington's Birthday, or the Fourth of July. Julia shows you how to be a log roller as well as how to make bark out of frosting, mushrooms from meringues, and moss out of spun sugar.

programme.title: Skarhult Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale gives a glimpse behind the scenes of the grand parties and dinners of the noble families of today.

programme.title: Château de Heks
programme.desc: Count and Countess d'Ursel have invited noble friends to a festive dinner to mark the international plant and flower show taking place on their estate.

programme.title: The Sea Urchin Dish
programme.desc: one of the most prized delicacies, sea urchin or "Uni" has an incredibly delicate flavor and texture. The challenge is to make a perfect bite that pairs with today's wine.

programme.title: The Ratatouille Dish
programme.desc: sometimes the simplest dishes can be the most difficult. Today the cast must master Ratatouille, a classic french village dish.

programme.title: San Sebastian
programme.desc: San Sebastian in Spain's Basque country is where restaurateur Nisha Katona believes truly incredible food is to be found. She takes Fred to the world's most experimental restaurant, Mugaritz, where they are wowed by the effort involved in delivering dishes that are more like crazy works of art than meals.

programme.title: Banana-Chocolate Beignets with Norman Love
programme.desc: Norman Love, corporate pastry chef of the Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, prepares cake, espresso profiteroles and choux.

programme.title: Secrets of Your Christmas Supermarket Food
programme.desc: Lifting the lid on the secrets of our festive food.

programme.title: Cape Town to Sligo
programme.desc: Our Tastes Like Home episode is a little different this week as we are looking at the life of someone who's moved away from her home in South Africa and is now living in Sligo, Catherine travels to Capetown, in South Africa to learn how to cook "Cape Malay Curries" so she can cook one for Berenice when she returns to Ireland.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The chef prepares a comforting breakfast from his childhood; cinnamon eggy bread with stewed apples. Youngest daughter Tilly helps in the kitchen with a hearty beef and ale stew, a sausage hotpot and a warming pear and ginger galette.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Phil and Christine make a bathing baby hippo to celebrate Penzance's Mazey Day Festival.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Eloise has received an order for a four foot-tall replica of the Statue of Liberty made entirely of cake, but with lots of icing.

programme.title: Wheat Harvest and Pasta
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Northern Italian Comforts
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: BRAISING SMALLER CUTS
programme.desc: Today it's all about the braise. To start, Lidia makes a unique Salad of Radicchio and Oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. She then makes a heartwarming Braised Chicken Thigh dish with Potatoes and Olives, a family favorite. For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.title: Party for Pennies
programme.desc: Frankie makes three dishes for a party of four, that when combined, are cheaper than just one meal out for brunch. Then, it's a taco party for five people for only $20!

programme.title: Food Back from the Dead
programme.desc: Stale bread, old bananas, canned food, dry foods... they've all gotten a bad wrap, but this is not the end of them yet! Don't let this stuff sit in the pantry, don't let it go to waste - Frankie encourages you to stretch further and cheaper!

programme.title: Dustin Wilson & Gianni Ottone
programme.desc: An ongoing series where wine professionals meet to blind taste each other on wines.

programme.title: Pasta Pasta Pasta
programme.desc: Piled with pasta love: pork bolognese tortellini with cheese rose, soft ricotta gnudi in tomato sauce, creamy gorgonzola pasta with pancetta and charred veggies.

programme.title: Comfort With a Kick
programme.desc: Spencer turns up the heat with Cajun shrimp cakes and creole étouffée, spicy Mexican beef pupusas, and Brazilian halibut and shrimp moqueca.

programme.title: Hot Soup Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer ladles up comforting bowls, including spicy spinach and Taleggio wonton soup in chorizo broth, jerk-rubbed chicken ramen, and rich cream of mushroom soup.

programme.title: Harvest Time Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer celebrates autumn by crafting hearty harvest-style dishes like black bean and kabocha squash soup, pumpkin gnudi, and caramel-apples-inspired treats.

programme.title: A Light and Delicious Supper
programme.desc: Baked swordfish with lemon, capers and vinegar; boiled potatoes with mint sauce.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a springtime menu with a table to match! There's fava beans and asparagus salad, lamb shoulder with artichokes and mint, sumac-lime green beans, deviled eggs, and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Tuna Casserole
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Tuna Casserole! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: The Rochester
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - The Rochester Garbage Plate! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Lifford/Maine & New Hampshire
programme.desc: In this episode, we first travel to Donegal to meet Ann to find out who is living away from home. Later Ann rustles up the dishes that remind James and Monica of home in Donegal, Snowballs and an Apple Pie. Catherine then travels to the US in hope to replicate Ann's dishes and bring a taste like home over to James and Monica.

programme.title: Desert Feast
programme.desc: Morocco (Sahara) Tony traverses the Moroccan desert with one goal in mind: eat a mud-oven-roasted sheep.

programme.title: My Hometown Favorites
programme.desc: New York, NY - Passionate about his city, Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, pan-seared foie gras, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

programme.title: Designer Duck
programme.desc: Julia's main course is an original duck dish, followed by a dessert of "Lemon Souffle Crepes," created by guest chef Yves Labbe.

programme.title: Barbecued Shrimp
programme.desc: Julia goes trawling for shrimp for her entree, guest chef Jean-Claude Prevot of Jean-Claude's in Dallas provides a spectacular duck dish for the first course, and Robert Mondavi is guest vintner.

programme.title: La Parra De Burrian Revisited
programme.desc: Since Gordon was last there, Laurence's menu has become hideously boring. The ex-pats seem to be their core diners, but the restaurant isn't developing itself to get the Spaniards in.

programme.title: Pub Classics
programme.desc: Tom reveals how to prepare classic, crowd-pleasing pub meals, such as a classic Caesar salad, quirky beer snacks, pork belly with lentils and cabbage salsa, fish and chips, and date and toffee pudding with toffee sauce. Hungry?

programme.title: Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: For many of us, we savor our hearty Sunday lunches at our favorite pub, and Tom would like to show us how to make them even more special. He starts with a classic roast beef, and ends with a lemon posset pudding, and a chocolate ale cake.

programme.title: Cancer
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Cancer! She starts with a homey sandwich featuring turkey, avocado, provolone, and mayo. The next dish is one any water sign would appreciate: crispy, cornmeal coated Fried Smelts with a spicy, garlicky dipping sauce! Next, Siobhan turns the comfort-food dial up to 11 with a modern take on a classic, Braised Veal Stroganoff! Finally, for a sign ruled by the moon, some lunar looking crepes with ricotta cheese and out of this world strawberry and rhubarb filling!

programme.title: Macaroni and Cheese with the Pratt Family
programme.desc: Itali's mac n' cheese is known far and wide as a dish not to be missed. But her daughter, Keyana, wants a shot at the crown. With the ooey gooey delicious reputation of Itali's recipe, Keyana's got a lot of convincing to do.

programme.title: Lobster
programme.desc: The American chef Ron Seigel challenges Iron Chef Sakai in this battle of lobster. Who will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Veal
programme.desc: The first female challenger at Kitchen Stadium, the 26-year-old Kagata defeated Chef Chen. Years later, she returns to fight Chen again with milk-fed veal.

programme.desc: Norman Love, corporate pastry chef of the Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, prepares cake, espresso profiteroles and choux.

programme.title: Family Kitchen Revival 104
programme.desc: Chef Jonathan helps Liz and Nick throw a pizza party theyll never forget as a thank you to friends, family and community that helped them after their daughter Mackenzie was born with a rare skin disease.

programme.title: Casting The Net Wide On Tybee Island
programme.desc: Tybee Island is home to fun locals, a deep history, and, of course, seafood so delicious that it, alone, was enough reason for Skye to make a return trip.

programme.title: Life Tastes Better On the Road
programme.desc: Damaris Phillips and NASCAR's Rutledge Wood discover that, at LUNCHBOXeats in Memphis, Southern food gets schooled and transformed into over-the-top, delectable eats. They indulge in a super-sized fried chicken and waffle sandwich at this hip, nostalgia-inspired spot. Next, the road leads to one of Charleston, South Carolina's best eateries, Hominy Grill, for a savory beignet fried up with shrimp and okra.

programme.title: Cocoa Lovin'
programme.desc: Handcrafting the world's greatest chocolate is no small task. Nonetheless, brothers Rick and Michael Mast have taken it on as their mission in life. Today Kimberly learns all that goes into making chocolate from bean to bar from these two cocoa wizards and then heads back to Nashville where she conjures up a decadent menu with special guest Kacey Musgraves.
